metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: someone talks to you, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: So any ATC controller might have up to maybe 20 planes

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: on the same frequency and then they talk to you,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: you have to talk back.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: And it feels right because there isn't more than 20 planes

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: around anyhow, so you can talk to everybody.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: But if there's 20,000 things around,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: you can't talk to everybody anymore.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: So we have to do something that's called digital,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: like text messaging.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: Like we do have solutions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: Like we have what, four or five billion smartphones

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: in the world now, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: And they're all connected.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: And somehow we solve the scale problem for smartphones.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: We know where they all are.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: They can talk to somebody and they're very reliable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: They're amazingly reliable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: We could use the same system,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: the same scale for air traffic control.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: So instead of me as a pilot talking to a human being

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: and in the middle of the conversation,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: receiving a new frequency, like how ancient is that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: We could digitize this stuff

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: and digitally transmit the right flight coordinates.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: And that solution will automatically scale

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: to 10,000 vehicles.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: We talked about empathy a little bit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: Do you think we will one day build an AI system

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: that a human being can love

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: and that loves that human back, like in the movie, Her?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: Look, I'm a pragmatist.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: For me, AI is a tool.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: It's like a shovel.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: And the ethics of using the shovel are always

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: with us, the people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: And it has to be this way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: In terms of emotions, I would hate to come into my kitchen

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: and see that my refrigerator spoiled all my food

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: and then have it explained to me

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: that it fell in love with the dishwasher

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: and it wasn't as nice as the dishwasher.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: So as a result, it neglected me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: That would just be a bad experience

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: and it would be a bad product.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: I would probably not recommend this refrigerator

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: to my friends.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: And that's where I draw the line.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: I think to me, technology has to be reliable

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: and has to be predictable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: I want my car to work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: I don't want to fall in love with my car.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: I just want it to work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: I want it to compliment me, not to replace me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: I have very unique human properties

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: and I want the machines to turn me into a superhuman.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: Like I'm already a superhuman today

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: thanks to the machines that surround me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: And I'll give you examples.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: I can run across the Atlantic

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: near the speed of sound at 36,000 feet today.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: That's kind of amazing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: My voice now carries me all the way to Australia

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: using a smartphone today.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: And it's not the speed of sound, which would take hours.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: It's the speed of light.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: My voice travels at the speed of light.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: How cool is that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: That makes me superhuman.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: I would even argue my flushing toilet makes me superhuman.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: Just think of the time before flushing toilets

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: and maybe you have a very old person in your family

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: that you can ask about this

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: or take a trip to rural India to experience it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: It makes me superhuman.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: So to me, what technology does, it compliments me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: It makes me stronger.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: Therefore words like love and compassion have very little,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: have very little interest in this for machines.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: I have interest in people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: You don't think, first of all, beautifully put,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: beautifully argued,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: but do you think love has use in our tools, compassion?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: I think love is a beautiful human concept.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: And if you think of what love really is,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: love is a means to convey safety, to convey trust.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: I think trust has a huge need in technology as well,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: not just people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: We wanna trust our technology

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: the same way we trust people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: In human interaction, standards have emerged

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: and feelings, emotions have emerged,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: maybe genetically, maybe biologically,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: that are able to convey sense of trust, sense of safety,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: sense of passion, of love, of dedication

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: that makes the human fabric.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: And I'm a big slacker for love.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: I wanna be loved, I wanna be trusted, I wanna be admired.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: All these wonderful things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: And because all of us will,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: we have this beautiful system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: I wouldn't just blindly copy this to the machines.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: Here's why.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: When you look at, say, transportation,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: you could have observed that up to the end

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: of the 19th century, almost all transportation

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: used any number of legs,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: from one leg to two legs to a thousand legs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: And you could have concluded that is the right way

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: to move about the environment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: We made the exception of birds, who use flapping wings.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: In fact, there were many people in aviation

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: that flapped wings to their arms and jumped from cliffs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: Most of them didn't survive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: Then the interesting thing is that the technology solutions

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: are very different.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: Like in technology, it's really easy to build a wheel.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: In biology, it's super hard to build a wheel.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: There's very few perpetually rotating things in biology

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: and they're usually one cell things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: In engineering, we can build wheels

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: and those wheels gave rise to cars.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: Similar wheels gave rise to aviation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: Like there's no thing that flies,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: that wouldn't have something that rotates,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: like a jet engine or helicopter blades.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: So the solutions have used very different physical laws

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: than nature and that's great.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: So for me to be too much focused on,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: oh, this is how nature does it, this is replicated.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: If you really believed that the solution

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: to the agricultural revolution was a humanoid robot,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: you would still be waiting today.

body.input: Again, beautifully put,

body.input: I'm not, yeah, that's right.

body.input: Good, you're right, I don't wanna.

body.input: I just made that up.

body.input: But you have a humor and a lightness about life

body.input: that I think is beautiful and inspiring to a lot of people.

body.input: Where does that come from?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: The smile, the humor, the lightness

body.input: amidst all the chaos and the hard work that you're in,

body.input: I just love my life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: I love the people around me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: I'm just so glad to be alive.

body.input: So I would be long dead now.

body.input: This is so amazing.

body.input: And then when you're alive and feel this every day,

body.input: then it's just so amazing what we can accomplish,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: what we can do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: We live in a world that is so incredibly vastly changing

body.input: every day, almost everything that we cherish

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: information more efficiently than before,

body.input: that all of a sudden, they were able to invent agriculture

body.input: Like living in that time is such a blessing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sebastian Thrun: Flying Cars, Autonomous Vehicles, and Education | Lex Fridman Podcast #59

body.input: We should sometimes really think about this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: Well, that's how I take it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: I mean, once again, people have different attitudes

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: towards it, all are welcome.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: What do you think is the difference

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: between the virtual world and the physical meat space world?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: That you are still drawn, for you personally,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: still drawn to the physical world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: Like there clearly then is a distinction.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: Is there some fundamental distinction

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: or is it the peculiarities of the current set of technology?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: In terms of the kind of virtual reality that we have now,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: it's made of software and software is terrible stuff.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: Software is always the slave of its own history,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: its own legacy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: It's always infinitely arbitrarily messy and arbitrary.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: Working with it brings out a certain kind

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: of nerdy personality in people, or at least in me,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: which I'm not that fond of.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: And there are all kinds of things

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: about software I don't like.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: And so that's different from the physical world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: It's not something we understand, as you just pointed out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: On the other hand, I'm a little mystified

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: when people ask me, well,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: do you think the universe is a computer?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: And I have to say, well, I mean,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: what on earth could you possibly mean

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: if you say it isn't a computer?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: If it isn't a computer,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: it wouldn't follow principles consistently

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: and it wouldn't be intelligible

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: because what else is a computer ultimately?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: And we have physics, we have technology,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: so we can do technology so we can program it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: So I mean, of course it's some kind of computer,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: but I think trying to understand it as a Turing machine

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: is probably a foolish approach.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: Right, that's the question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: Whether it performs, this computer we call the universe,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: performs the kind of computation that can be modeled

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: as a universal Turing machine,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: or is it something much more fancy,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: so fancy in fact,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: that it may be beyond our cognitive capabilities

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: to understand?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: Turing machines are kind of,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: I'd call them teases in a way,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: because if you have an infinitely smart programmer

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: with an infinite amount of time,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: an infinite amount of memory,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: and an infinite clock speed,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: then they're universal, but that cannot exist.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: So they're not universal in practice.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: And they actually are in practice

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: a very particular sort of machine within the constraints,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: within the conservation principles of any reality

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: that's worth being in probably.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: And so,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: I think universality of a particular model

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: is probably a deceptive way to think,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: even though at some sort of limit,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: of course something like that's gotta be true

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: at some sort of high enough limit,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: but it's just not accessible to us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: So what's the point?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: Well, to me, the question of like,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: whether we're living inside a computer or a simulation

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: is interesting in the following way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: There's a technical question is here.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: How difficult does it to build a machine,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: not that simulates the universe,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: but that makes it sufficiently realistic

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: that we wouldn't know the difference,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: or better yet, sufficiently realistic,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: that we would kind of know the difference,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: but we would prefer to stay in the virtual world anyway.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: I wanna give you a few different answers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: I wanna give you the one that I think

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: has the most practical importance to human beings right now,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: which is that there's a kind of an assertion

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: sort of built into the way the question's usually asked

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: that I think is false,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: which is a suggestion that people have a fixed level

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: of ability to perceive reality in a given way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: And actually, people are always learning, evolving,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: forming themselves.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: We're fluid too.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: We're also programmable, self-programmable,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: changing, adapting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: And so my favorite way to get at this

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: is to talk about the history of other media.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: So for instance, there was a peer review paper

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: that showed that an early wire recorder

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: playing back an opera singer behind a curtain

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: was indistinguishable from a real opera singer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: And so now, of course, to us,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: it would not only be distinguishable,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: but it would be very blatant

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: because the recording would be horrible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: But to the people at the time,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: without the experience of it, it seemed plausible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: There was an early demonstration

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: of extremely crude video teleconferencing

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: between New York and DC in the 30s, I think so,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: that people viewed as being absolutely realistic

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: and indistinguishable, which to us would be horrible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: And there are many other examples.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: Another one, one of my favorite ones

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: is in the Civil War era,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: there were itinerant photographers

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: who collected photographs of people

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: who just looked kind of like a few archetypes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: So you could buy a photo of somebody

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: who looked kind of like your loved one

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: to remind you of that person,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: because actually photographing them was inconceivable

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: and hiring a painter was too expensive,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: and you didn't have any way for the painter

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: to represent them remotely anyway.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: How would they even know what they looked like?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: So these are all great examples of how,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: in the early days of different media,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: we perceived the media as being really great,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: but then we evolved through the experience of the media.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: This gets back to what I was saying.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: Maybe the greatest gift of photography

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: is that we can see the flaws in a photograph

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: and appreciate reality more.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: Maybe the greatest gift of audio recording

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: is that we can distinguish that opera singer now

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: from that recording of the opera singer

body.input: Yeah, I would have loved to hear that conversation.

body.input: So the very last time I saw him, he was quite frail.

body.input: The first thing to say is that nobody can claim

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: This is all a matter of faith.

body.input: And in fact, I think the whole idea of faith

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: So it's not about God,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: but it's just about stuff in the universe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: We have faith in each other being conscious.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: And then I used to frame this as a thing called

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: And then it turned into a thing

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: for the animal rights movement.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: So I noticed Peter Singer using it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: I don't know if it was coincident or, but anyway,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: there's this idea that you draw a circle around yourself

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: and the stuff inside is more like you,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: of your consideration,

body.input: and the stuff outside the circle isn't.

body.input: And outside the circle might be a rock or,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: I don't know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: And that circle is fundamentally based on faith.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: Well, it's normally-

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: Your faith in what is and what isn't.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: The thing about this circle is it can't be pure faith.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: It's also a pragmatic decision.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: And this is where things get complicated.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: If you try to make it too big,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: you suffer from incompetence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: If you say, I don't wanna kill a bacteria,

body.input: I will not brush my teeth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: There's a competence question

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: where you do have to draw the line.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: People who make it too small become cruel.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: People are so clannish and political

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: and so worried about themselves

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: ending up on the bottom of society

body.input: that they are always ready to gang up

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: on some designated group.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: And so there's always these people

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: Well, give me a second.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: All right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: So there's a pragmatic consideration here.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: And so, and the biggest questions

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: are probably fetuses and animals lately,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: but AI is getting there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: Now with AI, I think,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: and I've had this discussion so many times,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: people say, but aren't you afraid if you exclude AI,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: you'd be cruel to some consciousness?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: And then I would say, well, if you include AI,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: you make yourself, you exclude yourself

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: from being able to be a good engineer or designer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: And so you're facing incompetence immediately.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: So like, I really think we need to subordinate algorithms

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: and be much more skeptical of them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: Your intuition, you speak about this brilliantly

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: with social media, how things can go wrong.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: Isn't it possible to design systems

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: that show compassion, not to manipulate you,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: but give you control and make your life better

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: if you so choose to, like grow together with systems.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: And the way we grow with dogs and cats,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: with pets, with significant others in that way,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: they grow to become better people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: I don't understand why that's fundamentally not possible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: You're saying oftentimes you get into trouble

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: by thinking, you know what's good for people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: Well, look, there's this question

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: of what framework we're speaking in.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: Do you know who Alan Watts was?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: So Alan Watts once said, morality is like gravity

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: that in some absolute cosmic sense,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: there can't be morality because at some point

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: it all becomes relative and who are we anyway?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: Like morality is relative to us tiny creatures.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: But here on earth, we're with each other.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: This is our frame and morality is a very real thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: Same thing with gravity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: At some point, you get into interstellar space

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: and you might not feel much of it,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: but here we are on earth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: And I think in the same sense,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: I think this identification with a frame that's quite remote

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: cannot be separated from a feeling of wanting to feel

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: sort of separate from and superior to other people

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: or something like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: There's an impulse behind it that I really have to reject.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: And we're just not competent yet to talk about

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: these kinds of absolutes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: Okay, so I agree with you that a lot of technologists

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: sort of lack this basic respect, understanding

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: and love for humanity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: There's a separation there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: The thing I'd like to push back,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: and it's not that you disagree,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: but I believe you can create technologies

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: and you can create a new kind of technologist engineer

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: that does build systems that respect humanity,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: not just respect, but admire humanity,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: that have empathy for common humans, have compassion.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: Not impossible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: So, I mean, no, no, no.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: I think, yeah, I mean, I think musical instruments

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: are a great example of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: Musical instruments are technologies that help people

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: connect in fantastic ways.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: And that's a great example.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: My invention or design during the pandemic period

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: was this thing called together mode,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: where people see themselves seated sort of in a classroom

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: or a theater instead of in squares.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: And it allows them to semi-consciously perform

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: to each other as if they have proper eye contact,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: as if they're paying attention to each other non-verbally

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: and weirdly that turns out to work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: And so it promotes empathy so far as I can tell.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: I hope it is of some use to somebody.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: The AI idea isn't really new.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: I would say it was born with Adam Smith's invisible hand,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: with this idea that we build this algorithmic thing

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: and it gets a bit beyond us

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: and then we think it must be smarter than us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: And the thing about the invisible hand is absolutely

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: everybody has some line they draw where they say,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: no, no, no, we're gonna take control of this thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: They might have different lines,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: they might care about different things,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: but everybody ultimately became a Keynesian

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: because it just didn't work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: It really wasn't that smart.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: It was sometimes smart and sometimes it failed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: And so if you really, people who really, really, really

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: wanna believe in the invisible hand is infinitely smart,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: screw up their economies terribly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: You have to recognize the economy as a subservient tool.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: Everybody does when it's to their advantage.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: They might not when it's not to their advantage.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: That's kind of an interesting game that happens.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: But the thing is, it's just like that with our algorithms.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: You know, like you can have a sort of a Chicago

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: economic philosophy about your computers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: You know, no, no, my things come alive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: It's smarter than anything.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: I think that there is a deep loneliness within all of us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: This is what we seek.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: We seek love from each other.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: I think AI can help us connect deeper.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: Like this is what you criticize social media for.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: I think there's much better ways of doing social media.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: That doesn't lead to manipulation,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: but instead leads to deeper connection between humans,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: leads to you becoming a better human being.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: And what that requires is some agency on the part of AI

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: to be almost like a therapist.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: I mean, a companion.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: It's not telling you what's right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: It's not guiding you as if it's an all-knowing thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: It's just another companion that you can leave at any time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: You have complete transparency control over.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: There's a lot of mechanisms that you can have

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: that are counter to how current social media operates

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: that I think is subservient to humans or no,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: deeply respects human beings

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: and is empathetic to their experience

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: and all those kinds of things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: I think it's possible to create AI systems like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: And I think they, I mean, that's a technical discussion

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: of whether they need to have

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: something that looks like more like AI versus algorithms,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: something that has identity,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: something that has a personality, all those kinds of things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: AI systems, and you've spoken extensively

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: how AI systems manipulate you within social networks.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: And that's the biggest problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: Isn't necessarily that there's advertisement

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: that social networks present you with advertisements

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: Maybe you can correct me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: Sure, so my-

body.input: I think the actual thing is even sort of more ridiculous

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218

body.input: and stupider than that, but that's okay.

body.input: So my question is, let's not use the word AI,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jaron Lanier: Virtual Reality, Social Media & the Future of Humans and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #218
