body.input: I know economic history broadly bears this out, but you have to be cautious.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: The cases where the system works are familiar to us because those are the states and the eras that produce a lot of written records.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: But when the system of trust collapses and the monetary system collapses with it, there's generally quite a paucity of records.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: I found that when I was writing Doom.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: And so we slightly are biased in favor of the periods when trust prevailed and the system functioned.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: It's very easy to point to a great many episodes of very, very intense monetary chaos, even in the relatively recent past.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: In the wake of the First World War, multiple currencies, not just the German currency, multiple currencies were completely destroyed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: The Russian currency, the Polish currency.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: There were currency disasters all over Central and Eastern Europe in the early 1920s.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: And that was partly because over the course of the 19th century, a system had evolved in which trust was based on gold

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: and rules that were supposedly applied by central banks.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: That system, which produced relative price stability over the 19th century, fell apart as a result of the First World War.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: And as soon as it was gone, as soon as there was no longer a clear link between those banknotes and coins and gold, the whole thing went completely haywire.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: And I think we should remember that the extent of the monetary chaos from certainly 1918 all the way through to the late 1940s.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: I mean, the German currency was destroyed not once, but twice in that period.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: And that was one of the most advanced economies in the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: In the United States, there were periods of intensely deep deflation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: Prices fell by a third in the Great Depression.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: And then very serious price volatility in the immediate post-World War II period.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: So it's a bit of an illusion.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: Maybe it's an illusion for people who've spent most of their lives in the last 20 years.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: We've had a period of exceptional price stability since this century began,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: in which a regime of central bank independence and inflation targeting appeared to generate steady below 2% inflation in much of the developed world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: It was a bit too low for the central bankers' liking.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: And that became a problem in the financial crisis.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: But we've avoided major price instability for the better part of 20 years.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: In most of the world, there haven't really been that many very high inflation episodes and hardly any hyperinflationary episodes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: Venezuela is one of the very few, Zimbabwe is another.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: But if you take a 100-year view or a 200-year view, or if you want to take a 500-year view,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: you realize that quite often the system doesn't work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: If you go back to the 17th century, there were multiple competing systems of coinage.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: There had been a great inflation that had begun the previous century.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: The price revolution caused mainly by the arrival of New World Silver.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: I think financial history is a bit messier than one might think.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: And the more one studies it, the more one realizes the need for the evolution.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: The reason bills of exchange came along was because the coinage systems had stopped working.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: The reason that banknotes started to become used more generally, first in the American colonies in the 17th century,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: then more widely in the 18th century, was just that they were more convenient than any other way of paying for things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: We had to invent the bond market in the 18th century to cope with the problem of public debt,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: which up until that point had been a recurrent source of instability.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: And then we invented equity finance because bonds were not enough.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: So I would prefer to think of the financial history as a series of crises, really, that are resolved by innovations.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: And in the most recent episode, very exciting episode of financial history,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: something called Bitcoin initiated a new financial or monetary revolution in response, I think, to the growing crisis of the fiat money system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: Can you speak to that? So what do you think about Bitcoin?

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: What do you think it is the response to? What are the growing problems of the fiat system?

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: What is this moment in human history that is full of challenges that Bitcoin and cryptocurrencies trying to overcome?

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: I don't think Bitcoin was devised by Satoshi, whoever he was, for fear of a breakdown of the fiat currencies.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: If it was, it was a very far sighted enterprise, because certainly in 2008, when the first Bitcoin paper appeared,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: it wasn't very likely that a wave of inflation was coming.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: If anything, there was more reason to fear deflation at that point.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: I think it would be more accurate to say that with the advent of the Internet,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: there was a need for a means of payment native to the Internet, typing your credit card number into a random website.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: It's not the way to pay for things on the Internet.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: I'd rather think of Bitcoin as the first iteration, the first attempt to solve the problem of how do we pay for things in what we must learn to call the metaverse,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: but let's just call it the Internet for old times sake.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: Ever since that initial innovation, the realization that you could use computing power and cryptography to create peer-to-peer payments without third party verification,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: a revolution has been gathering momentum that poses a very profound threat to the existing legacy system of banks and fiat currencies.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: Most money in the world today is made by banks, not central banks, banks.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: That's what most money is, it's entries in bank accounts.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: What Bitcoin represents is an alternative mode of payment that really ought to render banks obsolete.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: I think this financial revolution has got past the point at which it can be killed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: It was vulnerable in the early years, but it now has sufficient adoption and has generated sufficient additional layers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: I mean, Ethereum was in many ways the more important innovation because you can build a whole system of payments and ultimately smart contracts on top of Ether.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: I think we've now reached the point that it's pretty hard to imagine it all being killed,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: and it's just survived an amazing thing, which was the Chinese shutting down mining and shutting down everything.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: And still here we are. In fact, crypto is thriving.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: What we don't know is how much damage ill-judged regulatory interventions are going to do to this financial revolution.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: Left to its own devices, I think decentralized finance provides the native monitoring financial system for the internet.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: And the more time we spend in the metaverse, the more use we will make of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: The next things that will happen, I think, will be that tokens in game spaces like Roblox will become fungible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: As my nine-year-old spends a lot more time playing on computer games than I ever did,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: I can see that entertainment is becoming a game-driven phenomenon.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: And in the game space, you need skins for your avatar.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: The economics of the internet, it's evolving very fast.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: And in parallel, you can see this payments revolution happening.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: I think that all goes naturally very well and generates an enormous amount of wealth in the process.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: The problem is there are people in Washington with an overwhelming urge to intervene and disrupt this evolutionary process.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: Partly, I think, out of a muddled sense that there must be a lot of nefarious things going on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: If we don't step in, many more will go on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: This, I think, greatly exaggerates how much criminal activity is in fact going on in the space.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: But there's also the vested interests at work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: It was odd to me, maybe not odd, perhaps it wasn't surprising, that the Bank for International Settlements earlier this year published a report,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: one chapter of which said this must all go, must all stop.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: It's all got to be shut down, and it's got to be replaced by central bank digital currency.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: And Martin Wolf in the Financial Times read this and said, I agree with this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: And one suddenly realized that the banks are clever.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: They achieved the intellectual counterattack with almost no fingerprints on the weapon.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: I think central bank digital currency is a terrible idea.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: I can't imagine why we would want to copy a Chinese model that essentially takes all transactions and puts them directly under the surveillance of a central government institution.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: But that suddenly is a serious counter proposal.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: So on the one side, we have a relatively decentralized, technologically innovative, internet native system of payments

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: that has the possibility to evolve to produce a full set of smart contracts,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: reducing enormously the transaction costs that we currently encounter in the financial world

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: because it gets rid of all those middlemen who take their cut every time you take out a mortgage or whatever it is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: That's one alternative. But on the other side, we have a highly centralized system in which transactions will by default be under the surveillance of the central bank.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: Seems like an easy choice to me. But hey, I have this thing about personal liberty.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: So that's where we are. I don't think that the regulators can kill Web3.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: I think we're supposed to call it Web3 because crypto is now an obsolescent term.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: They can't kill it, but they can definitely make it difficult and throw a lot of sand into the machine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: And I think worst of all, they can spoil the evolutionary story by creating central bank digital currency that I don't think we really need.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: Or we certainly don't need it in the Chinese form.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: Do you think Bitcoin has a strong chance to take over the world, so become the primary?

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: You mentioned the three things that make money, money that become the primary methodology by which we store wealth, we exchange.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: No, no, I think what Bitcoin is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: This was a phrase that I got from my friend Matt McLennan, First Eagle, an option on digital gold.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: It's the gold of the system, but currently behaves like an option.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: That's why it's quite volatile, because we don't really know if this brave new world of crypto is going to work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: But if it does work, then Bitcoin is the gold because of the finite supply.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: What role we need gold to play in the metaverse isn't quite clear.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: I love that you're using the term metaverse. This is great.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: I just like the metaversity as the antithesis of what we're trying to do in Austin.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: I love it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: Can you imagine I'm using it sarcastically? I come from Glasgow, where all novel words have to be used sarcastically.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: So the metaverse, sarcastic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: But see, the beauty about humor and sarcasm is that the joke becomes reality.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: I mean, it's like using the word Big Bang to describe the origins of the universe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: After a while, it's in the textbooks and nobody's laughing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: Yeah, well, that's exactly right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: So sticky.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: Yeah, I'm on the side of humor, but it is a dangerous activity these days.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: Anyway, I think Bitcoin is the option of digital gold.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: The role it plays is probably not so much story value.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: Right now, it's just nicely not very correlated asset in your portfolio.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: When I updated the Ascent of Money, which was in 2018, 10 years after it came out, I wrote a new chapter in which I said Bitcoin,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: which had just sold off after its 2017 bubble, will rise again through adoption.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: Because if every millionaire in the world has 0.2% of his or her wealth in Bitcoin, the price should be $15,000.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: If it's 1%, it's $75,000. And it might not even stay at 1% because, I mean, look at its recent performance.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: If your exposure to global stocks had been hedged with a significant crypto holding, you would have aced the last few months.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: So I think the non-correlation property is very, very important in driving adoption.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: And the volatility also drives adoption if you're a sophisticated investor.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: So I think the adoption drives Bitcoin up because it's the option of digital gold.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: But it's also just this nicely not very correlated asset that you want to hold.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: In a world where, what the hell? I mean, the central bank is going to tighten.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: We've come through this massively disruptive episode of the pandemic. Public debt soared. Money printing soared.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: You could hang around with your bonds and wait for the euthanasia of the rentier.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: You can hang on to your tech stocks and just hope there isn't a massive correction or dot, dot, dot.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: And it seems like a fairly obvious strategy to make sure that you have at least some crypto for the coming year, given what we likely have to face.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: I think what's really interesting is that on top of Ethereum, a more elaborate financial system is being built.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: Stablecoins are the interesting puzzle for me because we need off-ramps.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: Ultimately, you and I have to pay taxes in US dollars. And there's no getting away from that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: The IRS is going to let us hold crypto as long as we pay our taxes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: And the only question in my mind is what's the optimal off-ramp to make those taxes, make those tax payments?

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: Probably it shouldn't be a currency invented by Facebook. Never struck me as the best solution to this problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: Maybe it's some kind of Fed coin or maybe one of the existing algorithmic stablecoins does the job.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: But we clearly need some stable off-ramp.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: So you don't think it's possible for the IRS within the next decade to be accepting Bitcoin as tax payments?

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: I doubt that. Having dealt with the IRS now since when did I first come here? 2002.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: It's hard to think of an institution less likely to leap into the 21st century when it comes to payments.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: No, I think we'll be tolerated. The crypto world will be tolerated as long as we pay our taxes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: And it's important that we're already at that point.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: And then the next question becomes, well, does Gary Gensler define everything as a security?

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: Do we then have to go through endless regulatory contortions to satisfy the SEC?

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: There's a whole bunch of uncertainties that the administrative state excels at creating because that's how the administrative state works.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: You're doing something new. Hmm. I'll decide whether that's a security, but don't expect me to define it for you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: I'll decide in an arbitrary way and then you'll owe me money.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: So all of this is going to be very annoying. And for people who are trying to run exchanges or innovate in the space, these regulations will be annoying.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: But the problem with fintech is it's different from tech, broadly defined.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: When tech got into e-commerce with Amazon, when it got into social networking with Facebook, there wasn't a huge regulatory jungle to navigate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: But welcome to the world of finance, which has always been a jungle of regulation because the regulation is there to basically entrench the incumbents.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: That's what it's for. So it'll be a much tougher fight than the fights we've seen of other aspects of the tech revolution because the incumbents are there and they see the threat.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: And in the end, Satoshi said it very explicitly. It's peer to peer payment without third party verification. And all the third parties are going, wait, what? We're the third parties.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: So there is a connection between power and money. You've mentioned World War I from the perspective of money.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: So power, money, war, authoritarian regimes. From the perspective of money, do you have hope that cryptocurrency can help resist war, can help resist the negative effects of authoritarian regimes?

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: Or is that a silly hope?

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: Wars happen because the people who have the power to command armed forces miscalculate. That's generally what happens.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: And we will have a big war in the near future if both the Chinese government and the US government miscalculates and they unleash lethal force on one another. And there's nothing that any financial institution can do to stop that any more than the Rothschilds could stop World War I.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: And they were then the biggest bank in the world by far with massive international financial influence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: So let's accept that war is in a different domain. War would impact the financial world massively if it were a war between the United States and China because there's still a huge China trade on. Wall Street is long China.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: Europe is long China. So the conflict that I could foresee in the future is one that's highly financially disruptive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: Where does crypto fit in? Crypto's obvious utility in the short run is as a store of wealth, of transferable wealth for people who live in dangerous places with failing, not just failing money, but failing rule of law.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: That's why in Latin America there's so much interest in crypto because Latin Americans have a lot of monetary history to look back on and not much of it is good.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: So I think that the short run problem that crypto solves is, and this goes back to the digital gold point, if you are in a dangerous place with weak rule of law and weak property rights, here is a new and better way to have portable wealth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: I think the next question to ask is, would you want to belong crypto in the event of World War III?

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: What's interesting about that question is that World War III would likely have a significant cyber dimension to it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: And I don't want to be 100% in crypto if they crash the Internet, which between them, China and Russia might be able to do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: That's a fascinating question, whether you want to be holding physical gold or digital gold in the event of World War III.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: The smart person who studied history definitely wants a bit of both.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: And so let's imagine World War III has a very, very severe cyber component to it with high levels of disruption.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: Yeah, you'd be glad of the old shiny stuff at that point.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: So diversification still seems like the most important truth of financial history.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: And what is crypto? It's just this wonderful new source of diversification.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: But you'd be nuts to be 100% in Bitcoin.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: I mean, I have some friends who are probably quite close to that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: Close to 100%, yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: I admire the balls of steel.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: Yeah, in whatever way that balls of steel takes form.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: You mentioned smart contracts.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: What are your thoughts about in the context of the history of money, about Ethereum, about smart contracts,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: about kind of more systematic at scale formalization of agreements between humans?

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: I think it must be the case that a lot of the complexity in a mortgage is redundant.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: That when we are confronted with pages and pages and pages and pages of small print,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: we're seeing some manifestation of the late stage regulatory state.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: The transaction itself is quite simple.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: And most of the verbiage is just ass covering by regulators.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: So I think the smart contract, although I'm sure lawyers will email me and tell me I'm wrong,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: can deal with a lot of the plain vanilla and maybe not so plain transactions that we want to do

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: and eliminate yet more intermediaries.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: That's my kind of working assumption.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: And given that a lot of financial transactions have the potential at least to be simplified,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: automated, turned into smart contracts, that's probably where the future goes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: I can't see an obvious reason why my range of different financial needs, let's think about insurance,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: for example, will continue to be met with instruments that in some ways are 100 years old.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: So I think we're still at an early stage of a financial revolution that will greatly streamline

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: how we take care of all those financial needs that we have, mortgages and insurance leap to mind.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: Most households are penalized for being financially poorly educated

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: and confronted with oligopolistic financial services providers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: So you kind of leave college already in debt.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: So you start in debt servitude.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: And then you've got to somehow lever up to buy a home if you can,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: because everybody's kind of telling you you should do that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: So you and your spouse, you are getting even more leveraged.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: And you're long one asset class called real estate, which is super illiquid.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: I mean, already I'm crying inside at the thought of describing so many households' financial predicament in that way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: And I'm not done with them yet because, oh, by the way, there's all this insurance you have to take out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: And here are the providers that are willing to insure you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: And here are the premiums you're going to be paying, which are kind of presented to you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: That's your car insurance. That's your home insurance.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: And if you're here, it's the earthquake insurance.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: And pretty soon you're just bleeding money in a bunch of monthly payments to the mortgage lender,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: to the insurer, to all the other people that lent you money.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: And let's look at your balance sheet. It sucks.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: There's this great big chunk of real estate. And what else have you really got on there?

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: And the other side is a bunch of debt, which is probably paying too high interest.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: The typical household in the median kind of range is at the mercy of oligopolistic financial services providers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: Go down further in the social scale and people are outside the financial system altogether.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: And those poor folks have to rely on bank notes and informal lending with huge punitive rates.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: We have to do better than this. This has to be improved upon.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: And I think what's exciting about our time is that technology now exists that didn't exist when I wrote The Ascent of Money to solve these problems.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: When I wrote The Ascent of Money, which was in 2008, you couldn't really solve the problem I've just described.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: Certainly you couldn't solve it with something like microfinance. That was obviously not viable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: Interest rates were high. The transaction costs were crazy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: But now we have solutions and the solutions are extremely exciting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: So FinTech is this great force for good that brings people into the financial system and reduces transaction costs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: Crypto is part of it, but it's just part of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: There's a much broader story of FinTech going on here where you get suddenly you get financial services on your phone.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: Don't cost nearly as much as they did when there had to be a bricks and mortar building on Main Street that you kind of went humbly and beseeched to lend you money.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: I'm excited about that because it seems to me very socially transformative.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: I'll give you one other example of what's great.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: The people who really get scalped in our financial system are senders and receivers of remittances,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: which are often amongst the poorest families in the world. The people who are like my wife's family in East Africa really kind of hand to mouth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: And if you send money to East Africa or the Philippines or Central America, the transaction costs are awful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: I'm talking to you, Western Union.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: We're going to solve that problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: Ten years from now, the transaction costs will just be negligible and the money will go to the people who need it rather than to rent-seeking financial institutions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: I'm on the side of the revolution with this because I think the incumbent financial institutions globally are doing a pretty terrible job.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: Middle-class and lower-class families lose out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: Thankfully, technology allows us to fix this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: FinTech can remove a lot of inefficiencies in the system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: I'm super excited myself, maybe as a machine learning person, in data oracles.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: So converting a lot of our physical world into data and have smart contracts on top of that so that no longer is there's this fuzziness about what is the concrete nature of the agreements.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: You can tie your agreement to weather.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: You can tie your agreement to the behavior of certain kinds of financial systems.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: You can tie your behavior to, I don't know, all kinds of things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: You can connect it to the body in terms of human sensory information.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: You can make an agreement that if you don't lose five pounds in the next month, you're going to pay me $1,000 or something like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: I don't know. It's a stupid example, but it's not because you can create all kinds of services on top of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: You can just create all kinds of interesting applications that completely revolutionize how humans transact.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: I think, of course, we don't want to create a world of Chinese-style social credit in which our behavior becomes so transparent to providers of financial services,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: particularly insurers, that when I try to go into the pub, I'm stopped from doing so.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: Every time you take a drink, your insurance goes up.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: Right, or my credit card won't work in certain restaurants because they serve, you know, ribeye steak.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: I fear that world because I see it being built in China.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: We must at all costs make sure that the Western world has something distinctive to offer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: It can't just be, oh, it's the same as in China, only the data go to five tech companies rather than to Xi Jinping.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: I think the way we need to steer this world is in the way that our data are by default vaulted on our devices,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: and we choose when to release the data rather than the default setting being that the data are available.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: That's important, I think, because it was one of the biggest mistakes of the evolution of the internet that in a way the default was to let our data be plundered.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: It's hard to undo that, but I think we can at least create a new regime that in future makes privacy default rather than open access default.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: In the book, Doom, The Politics of Catastrophe, your newest book, you describe wars, pandemics and the terrible disasters in human history,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: which stands out to you as the worst in terms of how much it shook the world and the human spirit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: I am glad I was not around in the mid 14th century when the bubonic plague swept across Eurasia.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: As far as we can see, that was history's worst pandemic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: Maybe there was a comparably bad one in the reign of the emperor Justinian, but there's some reason to think it wasn't as bad.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: The more we learn about the 14th century, the more we realize that it really was across Eurasia,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: and the mortality was 30% in some places, 50% in some places higher. There were whole towns that were just emptied.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: When one reads about the Black Death, it's an unimaginable nightmare of death and madness in the death with flagellant orders wandering from town to town,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: seeking to ward off divine retribution by flogging themselves, people turning on the local Jewish communities as if it's somehow their fault.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: That must have been a nightmarish time. If you ask me for a North Suran, a runner up, it would be World War II in Eastern Europe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: In many ways, it might have been worse because for a medieval peasant, the sense of being on the wrong side of divine retribution must have been overpowering.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: In the mid-20th century, you knew that this was manmade murder on a massive industrial scale.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: If one reads Broceman's Life and Fate, just to take one example, one enters a hellscape that it's extremely hard to imagine oneself in.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: These are two of the great disasters of human history. If we did have a time machine, if one really were able to transport people back and give them a glimpse of these times,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: I think the post-traumatic stress would be enormous. People would come back from those trips, even if it was a one-day excursion with guaranteed survival in a state of utter shock.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: You often explore counterfactual and hypothetical history, which is a fascinating thing to do, sometimes to a controversial degree.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: Again, you walk through that fire gracefully. Let me ask about World War II in general.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: What key moments in history of the 20th century do you think, if something else happened at those moments, we could have avoided some of the big atrocities?

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: Stalin's Hall-O-Mor, Hitler's Holocaust, Mao's Great Chinese Famine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: The great turning point in world history is August the 2nd, 1914, when the British cabinet decides to intervene.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: What would have been a European war becomes a world war. With British intervention, it becomes a massively larger and more protracted conflict.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: Very early in my career, I became very preoccupied with the deliberations on that day and the surprising decision that a liberal cabinet took to go to war,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: which you might not have bet on that morning because there seemed to be a majority of cabinet members who would be disinclined and only a minority, including Winston Churchill, who wanted to go to war.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: That's one turning point. I often wish I could get my time machine working and go back and say, wait, stop. Just think about what you're going to do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: By the way, let me show you a video of Europe in 1918. That's one.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: Can we linger on that one?

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: Sure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: That one, a lot of people push back on you on in the because it's so difficult. The idea is, if I could try to summarize, you're the first person that made me think about this very uncomfortable thought,

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: which is the ideas in World War I, it would be a better world if Britain stayed out of the war and Germany won.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: Thinking now in retrospect at the whole story of the 20th century, thinking about Stalin's rule of 30 years, thinking about Hitler's rise to power and the atrocities of the Holocaust, but also, like you said, on the Eastern Front, the death of tens of millions of people through the war.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: And also sort of the political prisoners and the suffering connected to communism, connected to fascism, all those kinds of things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: Well, that's one. It's one heck of an example of why you're just like fearless in this particular style of exploring counterfactual history.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: So can you elaborate on that idea and maybe why this was such an important day in human history?

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: This argument was central to my book, The Pity of War. I also did an essay in virtual history about this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: And it's always amused me that from around that time, I began to be called a conservative historian because it's actually a very left-wing argument.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: The people in 1914 who thought Britain should stay at the war were the left of the Labour Party, who split to become the independent Labour Party.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: What would have happened? Well, first of all, Britain was not ready for war in 1914. There had not been conscription.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: The army was tiny. So Britain had failed to deter Germany. The Germans took the decision that they could risk going through Belgium, using the Schlieffen Plan to fight their two-front war.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: They calculated that Britain's intervention would either not happen or not matter.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: If Britain had been strategically committed to preventing Germany winning a war in Europe, they should have introduced conscription 10 years before, had a meaningful land army, and that would have deterred the Germans.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: So the Liberal government provided the worst of both worlds, a commitment that was more or less secret to intervene that the public didn't know about.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: In fact, much of the Liberal Party didn't know about, but without really the means to make that intervention effective, a tiny army with just a few divisions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: So it was perfectly reasonable to argue, as a number of people did on August 2, 1914, that Britain should not intervene.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: After all, Britain had not immediately intervened against the French Revolutionary armies back in the 1790s.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: It had played an offshore role, ultimately intervening, but not immediately intervening.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: If Britain had stayed out, I don't think that France would have collapsed immediately as it had in 1870.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: The French held up remarkably well to catastrophic casualties in the first six months of the First World War.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: But by 1916, I don't see how France could have kept going if Britain had not joined the war.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: And I think the war would have been over perhaps at some point in 1916.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: We know that Germany's aims would have been significantly limited because they would have needed to keep Britain out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: If they'd succeeded in keeping Britain out, they'd have had to keep Britain out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: And the way to keep Britain out was obviously not to make any annexation of Belgium, to limit German war aims, particularly to limit them to Eastern Europe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: And from Britain's point of view, what was not to like?

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: So the Russian Empire is defeated along with France.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: What does that really change?

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: If the Germans are sensible, and we can see what this might have looked like, they focus on Eastern Europe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: They take chunks of the Russian Empire, perhaps they create as they did in the piece of Brest-Litovsk, an independent or quasi-independent Poland.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: In no way does that pose a threat to the British Empire.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: In fact, it's a good thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: Britain never had had a particularly good relationship with the Russian Empire after all.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: The key point here is that the Germany that emerges from victory in 1916 has a kind of European Union.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: It's the dominant power of an enlarged Germany with a significant Middle Europa, whatever you want to call it, customs union type arrangement with neighboring countries, including, one suspects, Austria-Hungary.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: That is a very different world from the world of 1917-18, the protraction of the war for a further two years, its globalization, which Britain's intervention made inevitable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: As Philip Zellico showed in his recent book on the failure to make peace in 1916, Woodrow Wilson tried and failed to intervene and broker a peace in 1916.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: I'm not the only counterfactualist here.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: The extension of the war for a further two years with escalating slaughter, the death toll rose because the industrial capacity of the armies grew greater.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: That's what condemns us to the Bolshevik Revolution.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: It's what condemns us ultimately to Nazism because it's out of the experience of defeat in 1918, as Hitler makes clear in Mein Kampf, that he becomes radicalized.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: He becomes radicalized and enters the political realm.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: Take out those additional years of war and Hitler's just a failed artist.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: It's the end of the war that turns him into the demagogue.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: You asked what are the things that avoid the totalitarian states?

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: As I've said, British non-intervention for me is the most plausible and it takes out all of that malignant history that follows from the Bolshevik Revolution.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: It's very hard for me to see how Lenin gets anywhere if the war is over.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: That looks like the opportunity for the constitutional elements, the liberal elements in Russia.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: There are other moments at which you can imagine history taking a different path.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: If the provisional government in Russia had been more ruthless, it was very lenient towards the Bolsheviks.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: But if it had just rounded them up and shot the Bolshevik leadership, that would have certainly cut the Bolshevik Revolution off.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: One looks back on the conduct of the Russian liberals with the despair at their failure to see the scale of the threat that they face and the ruthlessness that the Bolshevik leadership would evince.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: There's a counterfactual in Germany, which is interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: I think the Weimar Republic destroyed itself in two disastrous economic calamities, the inflation and then the deflation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: It's difficult for me to imagine Hitler getting to be Reich Chancellor without those huge economic disasters.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: Another part of my early work explored alternative policy options that the Weimar Republic might have pursued.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: There are other contingencies that spring to mind.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: In 1936 or 38, I think more plausibly 38, Britain should have gone to war.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: The great mistake was Munich.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: Hitler was in an extremely vulnerable position in 1938 because remember he didn't have Russia squared away as he would in 1939.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: Chamberlain's mistake was to fold instead of going for war as Churchill rightly saw.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: There was a magical opportunity there that would have played into the hands of the German military opposition and conservatives to snuff Hitler out over Czechoslovakia.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: I could go on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: The point is that history is not some inexorable narrative, which can only end one way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: It's a garden of forking paths.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: Many, many junctions in the road, there were choices that could have averted the calamities of the mid-20th century.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: I have to ask you about this moment before you said I could go on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: This moment of Chamberlain and Hitler snuff Hitler out in terms of Czechoslovakia and we'll return to the book Doom on this point.

metadata.title: Podcast: Niall Ferguson: History of Money, Power, War, and Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #239

body.input: What does it take to be a great leader in the room with Hitler or in the same time and space as Hitler to snuff him out, to make the right decisions?
