metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Saylor: Bitcoin, Inflation, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #276

body.input: I think the answer to the question of, well, is corruption possible is corruption is possible in all human institutions and all governments everywhere.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Saylor: Bitcoin, Inflation, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #276

body.input: The difference between digital property and physical property is when you own a building in Los Angeles and the city politics turn against you, you can't move the building.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Saylor: Bitcoin, Inflation, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #276

body.input: And when you own a share of a security that's like a US traded security and you wish to move to some other country, you can't take the security with you either.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Saylor: Bitcoin, Inflation, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #276

body.input: And when you own a bunch of gold and you try to get through the airport, they might not let you take it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Saylor: Bitcoin, Inflation, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #276

body.input: So Bitcoin is advantageous versus all those because you actually do have the option to withdraw your asset from the exchange.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Saylor: Bitcoin, Inflation, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #276

body.input: And if you if you had Bitcoin with Fidelity and you had shares of stock with Fidelity and if you had bonds and sovereign debt with Fidelity,

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Saylor: Bitcoin, Inflation, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #276

body.input: if you own some some mutual funds and some other random limited partnerships with Fidelity, none of those things can be removed from the custodian.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Saylor: Bitcoin, Inflation, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #276

body.input: But the Bitcoin you can take off the exchange, you can remove from the custodian.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Saylor: Bitcoin, Inflation, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #276

body.input: So it's still possible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Saylor: Bitcoin, Inflation, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #276

body.input: There's a deterrent. There's a deterrent.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Saylor: Bitcoin, Inflation, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #276

body.input: There's an anti-corrupting element and the phrase is an armed society is a polite society. Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Saylor: Bitcoin, Inflation, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #276

body.input: Because you have the optionality to withdraw all your assets from the crypto exchange, you can enforce fairness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Saylor: Bitcoin, Inflation, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #276

body.input: And at the point where you disagree with their policies, you can within an hour move your assets to another counterparty or take personal custody of those assets.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Saylor: Bitcoin, Inflation, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #276

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Saylor: Bitcoin, Inflation, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #276

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Saylor: Bitcoin, Inflation, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #276

body.input: And so what what makes digital property distinct is the fact that it has the most optionality for custody.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Saylor: Bitcoin, Inflation, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #276

body.input: Now, coming back to this digital energy issue, the real key point is the energy moves in milliseconds for free on layer threes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Saylor: Bitcoin, Inflation, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #276

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Saylor: Bitcoin, Inflation, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #276

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Saylor: Bitcoin, Inflation, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #276

body.input: And I don't think it makes any sense to even think about trying to solve all three problems on the layer one because it's impossible to achieve the security and the incorruptibility and immortality.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Saylor: Bitcoin, Inflation, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #276

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Saylor: Bitcoin, Inflation, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #276

body.input: I think the Ukraine war was a second shock. But I think that the Russian sanctions was a third shock.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Saylor: Bitcoin, Inflation, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #276

body.input: I think all three of them. And I think hyperinflation in the rest of the world is a fourth shock and then persistent inflation in the US is a fifth shock.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Saylor: Bitcoin, Inflation, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #276

body.input: So I think it's a perfect storm. And if you put all these events together, what do they signify?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Saylor: Bitcoin, Inflation, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #276

body.input: They signify the rational conclusion for any person thinking about this is, I'm not sure if I can trust my property.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Saylor: Bitcoin, Inflation, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #276

body.input: I don't know if I have property rights. I don't know if I can trust the bank.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Saylor: Bitcoin, Inflation, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #276

body.input: And if I'm politically at odds with the leader of my own country, I'm going to lose my property.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Saylor: Bitcoin, Inflation, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #276

body.input: And if I'm politically at odds with the owner of another country, I'm still going to lose my property.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Saylor: Bitcoin, Inflation, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #276

body.input: And when push comes to shove, the banks will freeze my assets and seize them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Saylor: Bitcoin, Inflation, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #276

body.input: And I think that that is playing out in front of everybody in the world, such that your logical response would be,

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Saylor: Bitcoin, Inflation, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #276

body.input: I'm going to convert my weak currency to a strong currency. Like I'll convert my peso and lira to the dollar.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Saylor: Bitcoin, Inflation, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #276

body.input: I'm going to convert my weak property to strong property. I'm going to sell my building downtown Moscow.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Saylor: Bitcoin, Inflation, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #276

body.input: And I'd rather own a building in New York City. I'd rather own in a powerful nation than be stuck with a building in Nigeria or a building in Argentina or whatever.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Saylor: Bitcoin, Inflation, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #276

body.input: I'd rather own a digital building than own a physical building.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Saylor: Bitcoin, Inflation, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #276

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: What's the key idea in there that's impactful?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: The key idea is that we've shifted the nature of how identity is done in the West from how

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: it was historically done.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: That basically for nearly all of human history, the way that we identify as human beings is

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: as a mix of our biological drives and then how that interacts with the social institutions

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: around us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: And so when you're a child, you're a bunch of unfettered biological drives and it's your

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: parents job to civilize you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: And civilize you literally means bring you into civilization, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: You learn the rules of the road.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: You learn how to integrate into institutions that already exist and are designed to shape

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: And it's how you interact with those institutions that makes you you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: It's not just a set of biological drives.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: And then in the modern world, we've really driven toward the idea that what we are is

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: how we feel on the inside without reference to the outside world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: And it's the job of the outside world to celebrate and reflect what we think about ourselves

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: on the inside.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: And so what that means is that we are driven now toward fighting institutions because institutions

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: are in positions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: So everything around us, societal institutions, these are things that are crimping our style.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: They're making us not feel the way that we want to feel.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: And if we just destroy those things, then we'll be freer and more liberated.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: It's a, I think, much deeper model of how to think about why our social politics, particularly

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: moving in a particular direction, is that a ground shift has happened in how people

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: think about themselves.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: And this has had some somewhat kind of shocking effects in terms of social politics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: So there's negative consequences in your view of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: But is there also a positive consequence of more power, more agency to the individual?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: I think that you can make the argument that institutions were weighing too heavily in

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: how people formed their identity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: But I think that what we've done has gone significantly too far on the other side.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: We basically decided to blow up the institutions in favor of unfettered feeling slash identity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: And I think that that is not only a large mistake, I think it's going to have diaramifications

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: So speaking about the nature of self, you've been an outspoken proponent of pro-life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: So what that means is we can take the full example or we can take sort of the partial

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: example.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: So if we take the full example, what that would mean is that up until point of birth,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: which is sort of the Democratic Party platform position, that a woman's right to choose ought

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: to extend for any reason whatsoever up to point of birth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: The only way to argue that is that bodily autonomy is the only factor.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: There is no countervailing factor that would ever outweigh bodily autonomy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: That would be the strongest version of the argument.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: If pregnancy changes women in a way that it doesn't change men, it's a form of sex discrimination

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: Those are the arguments.

body.input: X.

body.input: What's the strongest case for pro-life in your mind?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: The strongest case for pro-life is that from conception, a human life has been created.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: It is a human life with potential.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: That human life with potential now has an independent interest in its own existence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: If I may just ask a quick question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: Conception is when a sperm fertilizes an egg?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: Okay.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: Just to clarify the biological beginning of what conception means.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: Because that is the beginning of human life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: Now, there are other standards that people have drawn.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: Some people will say implantation in the uterus.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: Some people will suggest viability.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: Some people will say brain development or heart development.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: But the clear dividing line between a human life exists and a human life does not exist

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: is the biological creation of an independent human life with its own DNA strands and etc.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: Which happens at conception.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: Once you acknowledge that there is that independent human life with potential, and I keep calling

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: it that because people sometimes say potential human life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: It's not a potential human life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: It's a human life that is not developed yet to the full extent that it will develop.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: Once you say that and once you say that it has its own interest, now the burden of proof

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: is to explain why bodily autonomy ought to allow for the snuffing out of that human life

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: if we believe that human life ought not to be killed for quote unquote no good reason.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: You have to come up with a good reason.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: The burden of proof has now shifted.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: Now we'll find people who will say well the good reason is that it's not sufficiently

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: developed to outweigh the mental trauma or emotional trauma that a woman goes through

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: if for example she was raped or the victim of incest.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: And that is a fairly emotionally resonant argument but it's not necessarily positive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: You can make the argument that just because something horrific and horrible happened to

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: a woman does not rob the human life of its interest in life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: One of the big problems in trying to draw any line for the self-interest of life in

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: the human life is that it's very difficult to draw any other line that doesn't seem

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: somewhat arbitrary.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: If you say that independent heartbeat, well people have pacemakers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: If you say brain function, people have various levels of brain function as adults.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: If you say viability, babies are not viable after they are born.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: If I left a newborn baby on a table and did not take care of it, it would be dead in two

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: days.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: So once you start getting into sort of these lines, it starts to get very fuzzy very quickly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: And so if you're looking for sort of a bright line moral rule, that would be the bright

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: line moral rule.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: That's sort of the pro-life case.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: Well, there's still mysterious difficult scientific questions of things like consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: So what to you does the question of consciousness, how does it come into play into this debate?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: So I don't believe that consciousness is the sole criterion by which we judge the self-interest

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: in human life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: So we are unconscious a good deal of our lives.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: We will be conscious again.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: When you're unconscious, when you're asleep, for example, presumably your life is still

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: worth living.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: If somebody came in and killed you, that'd be a serious moral quandary at the very least.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: But the birth of consciousness, the lighting up of the flame, the initial lighting up the

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: flame, there does seem to be something special about that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: And it's a mystery of when that happens.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: Well, I mean, Peter Singer makes the case that basically self-consciousness doesn't

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: exist until you're two and a half.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: So he says that even infanticide should be okay.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: He's a bioethicist over at Princeton.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: So you get into some real dicey territory once you get into consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: Also the truth is that consciousness is more of a spectrum than it is a dividing line,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: meaning that there are people with various degrees of brain function.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

body.input: We don't actually know how conscious they are.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ben Shapiro: Politics, Kanye, Trump, Biden, Hitler, Extremism, and War | Lex Fridman Podcast #336

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: So what do you make of anonymity? Because it seems to be a fundamental aspect of the power of the app.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: Right. But at the same time, anonymity on the Internet.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: So it protects us. Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: It gives us freedom to have a voice, but can also bring out the dark sides of human nature,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: like trolls or people who want to be malicious, want to hurt others purely for the joy of hurting others, being cruel for fun and going to the dark places.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: So like, what do you make of anonymity as a fundamental feature of social interaction, like the pros and the cons?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: Yeah. Just to break that down a bit, I would say a lot of those same things about a place like Twitter, where people are very unanonymous.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: Having said that, of course, there's a different sort of capacity people have when they're anonymous. Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: In all different sorts of ways.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: So what do I make of anonymity?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: I think it can be incredibly liberating and allow people to be incredibly vulnerable and to connect in different ways, both on politics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: And there was a lot to talk about this year regarding politics and, you know, personally being vulnerable, talking about relationships and mental health.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: I think it allows people to have a community that's not performative.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: And of course, there's this other side where, you know, people can sometimes break rules or say things that they wouldn't otherwise say that people don't always agree with or that people might find repugnant.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: And to an extent, these can facilitate great conversations.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: And on the other hand, we have to have moderation in place and we have to have community guidelines to make sure that the anonymity doesn't overwhelm the purpose,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: which is that anonymity, first of all, anonymity is a tool in Librex.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: It was not the purpose of Librex.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: It is a way that we get towards these authentic conversations given our campus climate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: And second of all, I would say it's a spectrum.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: It's not just it's not just Librex is anonymous, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: Because Librex isn't totally anonymous.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: Everyone's a verified Ivy League student.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: You know exactly what school everyone goes to.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: You only have one account per person at Yale, meaning if meaning that I mean, what that amounts to is people have more of an ownership in the community and people know that they're connected and they have a common vernacular.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: So the anonymity is a scale and it's a tool.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: But you can also trust.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: I mean, this is the difference between Reddit's anonymity, where you can easily create multiple accounts.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: When you have only one account per person, or at least it's very difficult to create multiple accounts, then you can trust that the anonymous person you're talking to is a human being.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: Not a bot.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: I know a lot of intellectuals who would make a different decision.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: Yeah, interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: I had a discussion with Naval about this, actually, with a few others that have a very clear distinction between public and private.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: Something I'm struggling with, by the way, personally, and thinking about.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: So one on the very basic surface level is if you carry with yourself lies, small lies or big lies, it's extra mental effort to remember what you're supposed to say and not supposed to say.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: So that's on a very surface level of like, it's just easier to live life when you have the smaller the gap between the private you and the public you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: And the second is, I think for me, from an engineering perspective, like if I'm dishonest with others, I will too quickly become dishonest with myself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: And in so doing, I will not truly be able to think deeply about the world and come up and build revolutionary ideas.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: There's something about honesty that feels like it's that first principles thinking that's almost like overused as a term.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: But it feels like that requires radical honesty, not radical asshole and lishness, but radical honesty with yourself, with yourself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: And I feels like it's difficult to be radically honest with yourself when you're being dishonest with the public.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: You're not supposed to be told, but that is the task. They can take you just like you said, and depending who you are, they can take you really far.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: But at a certain point, you have to rebel. That could be getting, you know, that could be in your undergrad.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: That could be high school. So at any point, one thing that I think played a pretty pivotal role, and I've never really mentioned this, he might not even know the person about to tell you about in sort of me actually going on, making Librex was that

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: I was taking this graduate level math class my sophomore year, and I met this I met this PhD student who was also in it and had considerable citations and also startup experience.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: And I think he actually ended up being the CTO of a unicorn later on. I've sort of lost touch with him, but we're still Facebook friends as it as it is in the 21st century.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: So and I was in a class and I was telling him I really want to I really want to make this thing, but I have no technical background.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: And he disguised computer genius. He worked under Dan Spielman at Yale. So he's a good guy. Right. And we were doing some math together.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: We were doing something on discrepancy for those of you who really care about math. So combinatorics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: And he just turns to me is like, I think you could do it. Like, what do you mean? You think I could do is like, I think you could do it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: I was like, really? But I respected this guy so much. His name was Young Duck.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: Shout out to Young Duck. I respect this guy so much that I was like, if Young Duck says I can do it and Young Duck is a little genius, and he knows he knows me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: Because we were in two classes together and we spent a lot of time together. If he thinks I can do it, then who am I to say I can't do it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: Yeah, you know, that's a lesson for mentorship is like, oh, he has no idea. Probably.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: Well, he might not even remember that interaction, which is funny.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: But the point is that when a crazy young kid comes up to you with a crazy dream, you know, every once in a while, you should just pat him on the back and say,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: I believe in you. Like you can do it. If they look up to you, that means your words have power.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: And if you say no, no, come on, be like reasonable, like, you know, finish your schoolwork kind of thing like that's that's unreasonable to take that leap.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: Now just finish your education, blah, blah, blah, whatever, whatever the reasonable advice is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: Every once in a while, maybe often as a mentor, you should say, you know, go see about a girl in California or whatever the equal.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: It was my moment. That was my good will hunting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: It's your good will hunting moment. Man, I miss Robin Williams. I was a special guy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: People love it when I ask about book recommendations in general. Of course, your journey is just beginning.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: But is there something that jumps out to you? Technical fiction, philosophical, sci fi, coloring books, blog posts you read somewhere that had an impact on your life?

body.input: Video games.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: Do you recommend to others? Minecraft, manual?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: Manga.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: I mean, yeah, video. You could mention video games, too, if there's something that jumps out to you that just had like an impact.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: I guess I'll say I really like the book The War of Art, which is a book about creative resistance and the creative struggle and what it means to be creative.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: And part of what I see in this conversation and what you're doing, Lex, is so much of the War of Art's idea is that you just keep writing and writing and writing until you get to the new crap.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: And you just roll with it, right? And that's sort of what happens when you have like three hour conversations with people is you can only have so much scripted or societally constructed stuff until you get to the real you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: And you have to show up. I mean, that book is kind of painful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: It's really painful. And it's not something I would recommend for every part of it, but for what it did in my life at the time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: It also kind of normalized. I don't know. Part of my coming of age story is part of it's about realizing that I'm a creative person and person who needs to create.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: That's sort of a God given thing, I think, for a lot of people. But it's something that I don't really feel like I can live without.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: And part of it was realizing that even within some of these more rigid structures, it's OK that I don't sort of fit in with them. And to hear about the struggles of other creatives was something for my own self-esteem and my own growing up that was really important to me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: So I don't think the book itself might be perfect, but for what it did for my life, it was really impactful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: Yeah, I think exactly. The words may not be exactly right by way of advice, but I think the journey that a lot of creatives take by reading that book is kind of profound.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: He also has another one called Turning Pro, I think. I mean, he in general, as Baoz, is like taking it seriously.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: Like, if you have a creative mind and you want to create something special in this world, go do it. Don't show up. Look at the blank page.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: So many people would encourage me either blatantly or through implicit means to basically take the app less seriously.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: It's a good signal, by the way. It's a good signal because my really close friends, the ones who have always supported me, they never said that because they got it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: They understood that that was my path. And they might be skeptical. They might be like, I mean, one of my friends I remember told me, like, I was always like taken aback about why you were so certain this would work out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: And he's like, I finally got it once I saw it popping off. But before that, I just didn't get it. But he still supported me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: And I think it's a really good signal. And actually, just the fact of going through this process has made me socially feel so much more connected.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: And I've somewhat consolidated my social life to some degree, but it's so much more vulnerable connected. And that's part of the creative process. I have to thank for that, I think.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: There's something that's like unstoppable about the creative mind. It's like it's right there, that fire.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: And I guess part of the part of the thing that you're supposed to do is let that fire burn in whichever direction.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: And it's going to hurt. It's going to hurt. Fire will hurt. But on top of a video game, she's mentioned Stanley Parable offline.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: Is there you said you played some video games? Is there a video game that you especially love that you recommend I play, for example?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: Yeah, I'll mention it's actually really in keeping with what we've been talking about.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: It's the Beginner's Guide, which is what it was made by the same guy, Davey Rendon, who made the Stanley Parable, which I briefly saw you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: I just clicked the video and then I went to sleep. It was 2 a.m.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: But I briefly saw that you were looking at. And it's a game that is better treated as art.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: And I think I won't claim to understand the creator because that would be a cardinal sin to me as a creative person.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: But it gets to the heart of a lot of the things that we've been talking about, which is the creative mind.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: The game can be interpreted in a lot of ways, in a feminist way. It could be interpreted as the story of friends.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: It could be interpreted as the story of critics versus a creative.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: The way I like to interpret it, and I don't want to give out away too much, is the story of the creative part of your mind that creates just for the sake of creating.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: Meaning the part that creates for no rhyme or reason or clear meaning. It's almost ethereal.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: Versus the part that's, you could call it the editor, you could call it the pragmatist, you could call it the necessary force of ego.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: In our lives, we can't totally be egoless, right? But we need to be egoless to be creative.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: And how that sort of internal censure, what role does it play? And how do we allow our creative minds to be creative?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: And yet, how do we still become useful? Because it's funny that a video game could have this in.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: It's a fascinating tension, which reminds me about the ridiculous question that every once in a while I ask about meaning and death.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: So this whole ride ends. You're at the beginning of the ride, but it could end any day, actually.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: That's kind of the way human life works. You could die today, you could die tomorrow.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: Do you think about your own mortality? Do you think about death? Do you meditate on it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: And in that context, as the creative, but a pragmatist too, as running a startup, what do you think is the meaning of this whole thing?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: Yeah, so, on mortality, right? About three years ago, four years ago now, I was excited to go to Yale.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: I was playing six hours of squash a day, which squash is a sport I love so much.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: And I was really getting a lot better. And I was even thinking I could maybe walk onto the Yale team.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: And I woke up one day, I felt really, really sick. I went and I decided not to go squash that day.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: And I know, I wanted to, I almost did. And you'll see how this story turns out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: You'll decide if I made the right choice. I decided not to go squash today.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: And I decided to get my driver's license, or I had to get my driver's license because I wanted to get driver's license before I,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: you know, it's just how young I am before I went off to college because otherwise I might never get it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: And I'm going back and I successfully got my driver's license, for Hashem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: And I go back to my house and I decided I don't want to drive back because I just feel so sick.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: Like things are spinning. I have the worst headache. I come home, I run right into my bed and feeling really sick

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: to the point where I even like asked my mom, who is a doctor, I'm like, should I go to the hospital?

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: And she's like, you can just wait it out. I'm sure you'll get better.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: Like your mom.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: And then, you know, and then at one point I look at my arms and they're like covered in this like red splotchy stuff.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: Yeah. And I'm like, well, I think she's like, yeah, we have to go.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: And so I go there and they're like, you have scarlet fever and they're like, there's nothing we can do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: You should probably just go back home. So I go back home. Six hours later, I wake up in the morning.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: They let me out at like 3 a.m. They let me, I come home in the morning and I feel this like a spear through my chest.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: And I never felt anything like it. And I was, it was very disconcerting when you have a,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: because we're all used to different sorts of pain, right? And that was the sort of pain I never felt before.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: As much as an athlete, you're used to like feeling pain.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: So I tell my parents and immediately we hop back in the car. We go to the same hospital as that six hours ago.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: And they initially didn't want to let me in. And I was like, I have chest pain. They're like, oh, come in.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: Because they're like, you're a healthy guy. Wait your turn. And I'm like, no, you don't understand.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: I have like a pain in my chest. And then they let me in. They start doing tests on me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: They like put something like in my back, which is really scary. It's a huge needle.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: And I'm smiling because it's like one of the ways I ever do stress, I guess, or deal with this sort of thing and make light of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: But like know that, you know, it's definitely very scary in the moment. Shocking and scary.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: And they go and they do a bunch of tests and they determine that a virus like attacked my heart.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: And I had myocarditis and pericarditis. And they said I had maybe 25 to 35 percent chance at one point of dying.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: And so I'm sitting in my, they admit me into the hospital. I'm in my bed for about three weeks.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: And I'm just standing there. And I had this moment also that I remember very specifically where I was in so much pain

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: that like I was crying, not of like emotional standpoint, but actually just purely out of the pain itself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: Like I could feel my heart in my chest. And when I leaned back, I felt it touch my rib cage and feel horrible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: So I couldn't go to sleep and lean back. I had to lean forward all throughout the night. Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: And I'm feeling my and I'm feeling my chest. I'm feeling this terrible pain in my chest. I'm crying unstoppable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: And I mean, also, maybe I should mention that at the time I was someone who'd like refused to take in anything into my body that wasn't natural.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: And so a lot of the time I tried to be unmedicated. Eventually, I didn't allow them to add a little medication to my body.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: But there's just so much uncertainty and pain. And the first time I had to come to terms with mortality.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: First of all, I think you still should have gone play squash. I mean, come on. I mean, yeah, I thought you're I thought you're serious about this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: You still carry that with you sort of.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: There is power to realizing the ride can end right in very suddenly, very suddenly. Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: And painfully. And, you know, it has pragmatic application to like what you trajectories you take to life. Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: Something else that is worth noting is that I for the next year couldn't walk to my classes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: So I get to yell. They put me in a medical single alone. And I have to get shuttled to all my classes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: I have to ask. I ask a few professors to even move classes so I could actually get there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: I can't move my book. I can't lift my book bags. I can't I can't walk upstairs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: I spent like 12 hours a day in my dorm room just like staring at the walls and more so and more than that, all this like you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172

body.input: And for an 18 year old, I mean, I think every 18 year old has feelings about their body, man or woman.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ryan Schiller: Librex and the Free Exchange of Ideas on College Campuses | Lex Fridman Podcast #172
