body.input: Right, right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Power does corrupt, and I think that you can think about that again

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: from an evolutionary point of view.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: But I think that your question was a little deeper,

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: when that was, does the evolutionary interface idea

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: sort of unhinge science from some kind of important test for the theories, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: We don't want...

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: It doesn't mean that anything goes in scientific theory,

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: but if we don't see the truth,

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: is there no way to tether our theories and test them?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And I think there's no problem there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: We can only test things in terms of what we can measure

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: with our senses in space and time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So we're going to have to continue to do experiments,

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: but we're going to understand a little bit differently

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: what those experiments are.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: We had thought that when we see a pointer on some machine in an experiment,

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: that the machine exists, the pointer exists, and the values exist

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: even when no one is looking at them, and that they're an object of truth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And our best theories are telling us no.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: The pointers are just pointers,

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: and that's what you have to rely on for making your judgments.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: But even the pointers themselves are not the objective reality.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And I think Gödel is telling us that not that anything goes,

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: but as you develop new axiom systems,

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: you will find out what goes within that axiom system

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: and what testable predictions you can make.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So I don't think we're untethered.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: We continue to do experiments.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: What I think we won't have that we want is a conceptual understanding

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: that gives us a theory of everything that's final and complete.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: I think that this is, to put it another way,

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: this is job security for scientists.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Our job will never be done.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: It's job security for neuroscience.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Because before we thought that when we looked in the brain,

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: we saw neurons and neural networks and action potentials and synapses

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: and so forth, and that was it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: That was the reality.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Now we have to reverse engineer that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: We have to say what is beyond space-time?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: What is going on?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: What is a dynamical system beyond space-time

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: that when we project it into Einstein's space-time

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: gives us things that look like neurons and neural networks and synapses?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So we have to reverse engineer it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So there's going to be lots more work for neuroscience.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: It's going to be far more complicated and difficult and challenging.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: But that's wonderful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: That's what we need to do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: We thought neurons exist when they aren't perceived, and they don't.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: In the same way that if I show you, when I say they don't exist,

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: I should be very, very concrete.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: If I draw on a piece of paper a little sketch of something

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: that is called the Necker cube, it's just a little line drawing of a cube,

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: it's on a flat piece of paper.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: If I execute it well and I show it to you, you'll see a 3D cube,

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: and you'll see it flip.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Sometimes you'll see one face in front, sometimes you'll see the other face in front.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: But if I ask you, which face is in front when you don't look?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: The answer is, well, neither face is in front because there's no cube.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: It's just a flat piece of paper.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So when you look at the piece of paper, you perceptually create the cube.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And when you look at it, then you fix one face to be in front and one face to be in.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So that's what I mean when I say it doesn't exist.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Spacetime itself is like the cube.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: It's a data structure that your sensory systems construct,

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: whatever your sensory systems mean now,

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: because we now have to not even take that for granted.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: But there are perceptions that you construct on the fly,

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: and they're data structures in a computer science sense,

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: and you garbage collect them when you don't need them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So you create them and garbage collect them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: But is it possible that it's mapped well in some concrete,

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: predictable way to objective reality?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: The sheet of paper, this two-dimensional space,

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: or we can talk about spacetime, maps in some way that we maybe don't yet understand,

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: but we'll one day understand what that mapping is, but it maps reliably.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: It is tethered in that way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Well, yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And so the new theories that the physicists are finding beyond spacetime have that kind of tethering.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: They show precisely how you start with an amplitude hydron and how you project this high-dimensional structure

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: into the four dimensions of spacetime.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So there's a precise procedure that relates the two.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And they're doing the same thing with the cosmological polytopes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So they're the ones that are making the most concrete and fun advances going beyond spacetime.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And they're tethering it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: They say this is precisely the mathematical projection from this deeper structure into spacetime.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: One thing I'll say about, as a non-physicist, what I find interesting is that they're finding just geometry,

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: but there's no notion of dynamics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Right now, they're just finding these static geometric structures, which is impressive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: I'm not putting them down.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: This is what they're doing is unbelievably complicated and brilliant and adventurous.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: It's all those things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And beautiful from a human aesthetic perspective because geometry is beautiful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Absolutely.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And they're finding symmetries that are true of the data that can't be seen in spacetime.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: But I'm looking for a theory beyond spacetime that's a dynamical theory.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: I would love to find, and we can talk about that at some point, a theory of consciousness in which

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: the dynamics of consciousness itself will give rise to the geometry that the physicists are finding beyond spacetime.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: If we can do that, then we'd have a completely different way of looking at how consciousness is related

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: to what we call the brain or the physical world more generally.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Right now, all of my brilliant colleagues, 99% of them are trying to...

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: They're assuming spacetime is fundamental.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: They're assuming that particles are fundamental, quarks, gluons, leptons, and so forth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Elements, atoms, and so forth are fundamental, and that therefore neurons and brains are part of objective reality.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And that somehow when you get matter that's complicated enough, it will somehow generate conscious experiences

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: by its functional properties.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Or if you're panpsychist, maybe in addition to the physical properties of particles, you add consciousness property as well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And then you combine these physical and conscious properties to get more complicated ones.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: But they're all doing it within spacetime.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: All of the work that's being done on consciousness and its relationship to the brain is all assumed something that

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: our best theories are telling us is doomed, spacetime.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Why does that particular assumption bother you the most?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So you bring up spacetime.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: I mean, that's just one useful interface we've used for a long time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Surely there's other interfaces.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Is spacetime just one of the big ones to build up people's intuition about the fact that they do assume a lot of things strongly?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Or is it in fact the fundamental flaw in the way we see the world?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Well, everything else that we think we know are things in spacetime.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Sure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And so when you say spacetime is doomed, this is a shot to the heart of the whole framework, the whole conceptual framework that we've had in science.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Not to the scientific method, but to the fundamental ontology and also the fundamental methodology, the ontology of spacetime and its contents.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And the methodology of reductionism, which is that as we go to smaller scales in spacetime, we will find more and more fundamental laws.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And that's been very useful for space and time for centuries, reductionism for centuries.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: But now we realize that that's over.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Reductionism is in fact dead as is spacetime.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: What exactly is reductionism?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: What is the process of reductionism that is different than some of the physicists that you mentioned that are trying to think, trying to let go of the assumption of spacetime?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Looking beyond, isn't that still trying to come up with a simple model that explains this whole thing?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Isn't it still reducing?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: That's a wonderful question because it really helps to clarify two different notions, which is scientific explanation on the one hand and a particular kind of scientific explanation on the other, which is the reductionist.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So the reductionist explanation is saying, I will start with things that are smaller in spacetime and therefore more fundamental, where the laws are more fundamental.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So we go to just smaller and smaller scales.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Whereas in science more generally, we just say like when Einstein did the special theory of relativity, he's saying, let me have a couple postulates.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: I will assume that the speed of light is universal for all observers in uniform motion and that the laws of physics for uniform motion are the same.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: That's not a reductionist.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Those are saying, grant me these assumptions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: I can build this entire concept of spacetime out of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: It's not a reductionist thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: You're not going to smaller and smaller scales of space.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: You're coming up with these deep, deep principles.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Same thing with this theory of gravity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: It's the falling elevator idea.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So this is not a reductionist kind of thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: It's something different.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So simplification is a bigger thing than just reductionism?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Reductionism has been a particularly useful kind of scientific explanation, for example, in thermodynamics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: The notion that we have of heat, some macroscopic thing like temperature and heat.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: It turns out that Neale Boltzmann and others discovered, well, hey, if we go to smaller and smaller scales, we find these things called molecules or atoms.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And if we think of them as bouncing around and having some kind of energy, then what we call heat really can be reduced to that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And so that's a particularly useful kind of reduction, is a useful kind of scientific explanation that works within a range of scales within spacetime.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: But we know now precisely where that has to stop at 10 to the minus 33 centimeters and 10 to the minus 43 seconds.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And I would be impressed if it was 10 to the minus 33 trillion centimeters.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: I'm not terribly impressed at 10 to the minus 33 centimeters.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So David Marr was a professor at MIT, but he'd done his PhD in neuroscience studying just the architectures of the brain.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: But he realized that his work was on the cerebellum. He realized that his work, as rigorous as it was, left him unsatisfied because he didn't know what the cerebellum was for and why it had that architecture.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So he went to MIT and he was in the AI lab there. He had this three-level approach that really grabbed my attention.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So when I was an undergrad at UCLA, I read one of his papers in a class and said, who is this guy?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And so to really do neuroscience, he argued, we needed to have understanding at all those levels.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And that really got me. I loved the neuroscience, but I realized this guy was saying if you can't build it, you don't understand it effectively.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And so that's why I went to MIT. And I had the pleasure of working with David until he died just a year and a half later.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So there's been that idea that with neuroscience, we have to have in some sense a top-down model of what's being computed and why that we would then go after.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: But the other thing that you mentioned though, what about just being? What if we decide instead of all this doing and exploring, what about being?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: My guess is that the best scientists will do both and that the act of being will be a place where they get many of their ideas

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: and that they then pull into the conceptual realm. I think many of the best scientists, like Einstein comes to mind,

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: where these guys say, look, I didn't come up with these ideas by a conceptual analysis.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: I was thinking in vague images and it was just something non-conceptual.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And then it took me a long, long time to pull it out into concepts and then longer to put it into math.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: But the real insights didn't come from just slavishly playing with equations. They came from a deeper place.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And so there may be this going back and forth between the complete non-conceptual where there's essentially no end to the wisdom

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: and then conceptual systems where there's the girdle limits that we have to that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And that may be, if consciousness is important and fundamental, that may be what consciousness, at least part of what consciousness is about,

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: is this discovering itself, discovering its possibilities, so to speak. We can talk about what that might mean.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: By going from the non-conceptual to the conceptual and back and forth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: To get better and better and better at being.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Right. Let me ask you just to linger on the evolutionary, because you mentioned evolutionary game theory

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: and that's really where you, the perspective from which you come to form the case against reality.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: At which point in our evolutionary history do we start to deviate the most from reality?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Is it way before life even originated on earth? Is it in the early development from bacteria and so on?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Or is it when some inklings of what we think of as intelligence or maybe even complex consciousness started to emerge?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So where did this deviation, just like with the interfaces in a computer, you start with transistors and then you have assembly

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: and then you have C, C++, then you have Python, then you have GUIs, all that kind of, you have layers upon layers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: When do we start to deviate?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Well, David Maher, again, my advisor at MIT, in his book, Vision, suggested that the more primitive sensory systems

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: were less realistic, less veridical, but that by the time you got to something as complicated as the humans,

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: we were actually estimating the true shapes and distances to objects and so forth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So his point of view, and I think it was probably, it's not an uncommon view among my colleagues,

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: that yeah, the sensory systems of lower creatures may just not be complicated enough to give them much truth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: But as you get to 86 billion neurons, you can now compute the truth or at least the parts of the truth that we need.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: When I look at evolutionary game theory, one of my graduate students, Justin Mark, did some simulations using genetic algorithms.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So there he was just exploring, we start off with random organisms, random sensory genetics and random actions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And the first generation was unbelievably, it was a foraging situation, they were foraging for resources.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Most of them stayed in one place, didn't do anything important.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: But we could then just look at how the genes evolved.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And what we found was, what he found was that basically you never even saw the truth organisms even come on the stage.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: If they came up, they were gone in one generation, they just weren't.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So they came and went, even just in one generation, they just are not good enough.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: The ones that were just tracking, their senses just were tracking the fitness payoffs, were far more fit than the truth seekers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So an answer at one level, I want to give an answer at a deeper level, but just with evolutionary game theory.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Because my attitude as a scientist is, I don't believe any of our theories.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: I take them very, very seriously. I study them, I look at their implications, but none of them are the gospel.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: They're just the latest ideas that we have.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So the reason I study evolutionary game theory is because that's the best tool we have right now in this area.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: There is nothing else that competes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So as a scientist, it's my responsibility to take the best tools and see what they mean.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And the same thing the physicists are doing. They're taking the best tools and looking at what they entail.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: But I think that science now has enough experience to realize that we should not believe our theories in the sense that we've now arrived.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: In 1890, it was a lot of physicists thought we'd arrived.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: They were discouraging bright young students from going into physics because it was all done.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And that's precisely the wrong attitude forever. It's the wrong attitude forever.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: The attitude we should have is a century from now, they'll be looking at us and laughing at what we didn't know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And we just have to assume that that's going to be the case.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Just know that everything that we think is so brilliant right now, our final theory, a century from now, they'll look at us like we look at the physicists of 1890 and go, how could they have been so dumb?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So I don't want to make that mistake. So I'm not doctrinaire about any of our current scientific theories.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: I am doctrinaire about this. We should use the best tools we have right now.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: With humility. Well, so let me ask you about game theory.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: I love game theory, evolutionary game theory, but I'm always suspicious of it, like economics. When you construct models, it's too easy to construct things that oversimplify just because we, our human brains, enjoy the simplification of constructing a few variables that somehow represent organisms or represent people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And running a simulation that then allows you to build up intuition and then it feels really good because you can get some really deep and surprising intuitions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: But how do you know your models aren't the assumptions underlying your models on some fundamentally flawed and because of that, your conclusions are fundamentally flawed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So I guess my question is what are the limits in your use of game theory, evolutionary game theory, your experience with it? What are the limits of game theory?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So I've gotten some pushback from professional colleagues and friends who have tried to rerun simulations and try to, I mean, the idea that we don't see the truth is not comfortable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And so many of my colleagues are very interested in trying to show that we're wrong. And so the idea would be to say that somehow we did something, as you're suggesting, maybe something special that wasn't completely general.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: We've got some little special part of the whole search space in evolutionary game theory in which this happens to be true, but more generally organisms would evolve to see the truth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So the best pushback we've gotten is from a team at Yale and they suggested that if you use thousands of payoff functions, so in our simulations we just use a couple, one or two, because it was our first simulations, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So that would be a limit. We had one or two payoff functions. We showed the result in those, at least for the genetic algorithms.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And they said if you have 20,000 of them, then we can find these conditions in which truth-seeking organisms would be the ones that evolved and survived.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And so we looked at their simulations and it certainly is the case that you can find special cases in which truth can evolve.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So when I say it's probability zero, it doesn't mean it can't happen. It can happen. In fact, it could happen infinitely often. It's just probability zero.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So probability zero things can happen infinitely often.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: When you say probability zero, you mean probability close to zero.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: To be very precise. So for example, if I have a unit square on the plane and I use a measure in which the, a probability measure in which the area of a region is this probability,

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: then if I draw a curve in that unit square, it has measure precisely zero, precisely, not approximately, precisely zero.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And yet it has infinitely many points. So there is an object that for that probability measure has probability zero and yet there's infinitely many points on it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So that's what I mean when I say that the things that are probability zero can happen infinitely often in principle.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Yeah, but infinity as far as I, and I look outside often at walk around and I look at people. I haven't never seen infinity in real life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: That's an interesting issue.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: I've been looking, I've been looking. I don't notice it infinitely small or the infinitely big.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And so the tools of mathematics, you could sort of apply the same kind of criticism that it is a very convenient interface into our reality.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: That's a big debate in mathematics, the intuitionist versus the ones who take, for example, the real numbers as real.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And that's a fun discussion. Nicholas Gieson has a physicist that said really interesting work recently on how if you go with intuitionist mathematics,

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: you could effectively quantize Newton and you find that Newtonian theory and quantum theory aren't that different once you go with it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: It's funny.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: It's really quite interesting. So the issue he raises is a very, very deep one and one that I think we should take quite seriously,

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: which is how should we think about the reality of the contours hierarchy, aluf one, aluf two, and all these different infinities versus just a more algorithmic approach, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So where everything's computable in some sense, everything's finite, as big as you want, but nevertheless finite.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So yeah, they ultimately boils down to whether the world is discrete or continuous in some general sense.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And again, we can't really know, but there's just a mind breaking thought, just common sense reasoning that something can happen

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: and is yet probability of it happening is zero percent. That doesn't compute for common sense computer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Right. This is where you have to be a sharp mathematician to really, and I'm not.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Sharp is one word. What I'm saying is common sense computer is, I mean that in a very kind of, in a positive sense,

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: because we've been talking about perception systems and interfaces, if we were, if we are to reason about the world, we have to use the best interfaces we got.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And I'm not exactly sure that game theory is the best interface we got for this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Oh, right. And application of mathematics, tricks and tools of mathematics, the game theory is the best we got when we are thinking about the nature of reality

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: and fitness functions and evolution period.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Well, that's a fair rejoinder. And I think that that was the tool that we used.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And if someone says here's a better mathematical tool and here's why this is this mathematical tool better captures the essence of Darwin's idea.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: John Maynard Smith didn't quite get it with evolutionary game theory. There's this better this thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Now, there are tools like evolutionary graph theory, which generalize evolutionary game theory. And then there's quantum game theory.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So so you can you can use quantum tools like entanglement, for example, as a resource in games that that change the very nature of the solutions of the optimal solutions of the game theory.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: I think the work from Yale is really interesting. It's a really interesting challenge of that kind of these ideas where, OK, if you have a very large number of fitness functions or let's say you have

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: a nearly infinite number of fitness functions or a growing number of fitness functions, what what kind of interesting things start to emerging emerging if you are to be an organism,

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: if to be an organism that adapts means having to deal with an ensemble of fitness functions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Right. And so we've actually redone some of our own work based on theirs. And this is the back and forth that we expect in science.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Right. And what we found was that they in their simulations, they were assuming that you couldn't carve the world up into objects.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And so we said, well, let's relax that assumption, allow organisms to create data structures that we might call objects.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And an object would be you take you would do hierarchical clustering of your fitness payoff functions, the ones that have similar shapes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: If you have twenty thousand of them, maybe these fifty are all very, very similar.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So I can take all the perception, action, fitness stuff and make that into a data structure and we'll call that a unit or an object.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And as soon as we did that, then all of their results went away.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: It turned out they were the special case and that the the organisms that were allowed to only see that were shaped to see only fitness payoffs were the ones that were.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So the idea is that objects then what are objects from an evolutionary point of view, this bottle.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: We thought that when I saw a bottle, it was because I was seeing a true object that existed, whether or not it was perceived.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Evolutionary theories suggest a different interpretation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: I'm seeing a data structure that is encoding a convenient way of looking at various fitness payoffs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: I can use this for drinking. I could use it as a weapon. Not a very good one. I could beat someone with head with it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: If my goal is mating, this is pointless.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So I'm seeing for what I'm coding here is all sorts of actions and the payoffs that I could get.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: When I pick up an apple, now I'm getting a different set of actions and pay and payoffs for when I pick up a rock I'm getting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So for every object, what I'm getting is a different set of payoff functions and act with various actions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And so once you allow that, then what you find is once again that truth goes extinct and the organisms that just get an interface are the ones that win.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: But the question just sneaking up on this is fascinating.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: From where do fitness functions originate? What gives birth to the fitness functions?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So if there's a giant black box that just keeps giving you fitness functions, what are we trying to optimize?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: You said that water has different uses than an apple. So there's these objects. What are we trying to optimize?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And why is not reality a really good generator of fitness functions?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So each theory makes its own assumptions and says, grant me this and I'll explain that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So evolutionary game theory says grant me fitness payoffs and grant me strategies with payoffs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And I can write down the matrix for this strategy interacts with that strategy. These are the payoffs that come up.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: If you grant me that, then I can start to explain a lot of things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Now you can ask for a deeper question like, okay, how does physics evolve biology and where do these fitness payoffs come from?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Now that's a completely different enterprise. And of course, evolutionary game theory then would be not the right tool for that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: It would have to be a deeper tool that shows where evolutionary game theory comes from.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: My own take is that there's going to be a problem in doing that because space time isn't fundamental.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: It's just a user interface. And that the distinction that we make between living and nonliving is not a fundamental distinction.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: It's an artifact of the limits of our interface.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So this is a new wrinkle and this is an important wrinkle.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: It's so nice to take space and time as fundamental because if something looks like it's inanimate, it's inanimate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: We can just say it's not living. Now it's much more complicated. Certain things are obviously living.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: I'm talking with you. I'm obviously interacting with something that's alive and conscious.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: I think we've let go of the word obviously in this conversation. I think nothing is obvious.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Nothing is obvious. That's right. But when we get down to like an ant, it's obviously living, but I'll say it appears to be living.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: When we get down to a virus, now people wonder. And when we get down to protons, people say it's not living.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And my attitude is look, I have a user interface. The interface is there to hide certain aspects of reality and others to...

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: It's an uneven representation, put it that way. Certain things just get completely hidden.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Dark matter and dark energy are most of the energy and matter that's out there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Our interface just plain flat out hides them. The only way we get some hint is because gravitational things are going wrong within our...

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So most things are outside of our interface. The distinction between living and non-living is not fundamental.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: It's an artifact of our interface. So if we really want to understand where evolution comes from, to answer the question, the deep question you asked,

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: I think the right way we're going to have to do that is to come up with a deeper theory than space-time, in which there may not be the notion of time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And show that whatever this dynamics of that deeper theory is...

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: By the way, I'll talk about how you could have dynamics without time, but the dynamics of this deeper theory, when we project it into...

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: In certain ways, then we do get space-time and we get what appears to be evolution by natural selection. So I would love to see evolution by natural selection,

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: nature, red and tooth and claw, people fighting, animals fighting for resources and the whole bit, come out of a deeper theory in which perhaps it's all cooperation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: There's no limited resources and so forth. But as a result of projection, you get space and time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And as a result of projection, you get nature, red and tooth and claw, the appearance of it. But it's all an artifact of the interface.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: I like this idea that the line between living and nonliving is very important.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Because that's the thing that would emerge before you have evolution, the idea of death.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So that seems to be an important component of natural selection. And if that emerged, because that's also...

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Asking the question that I guess I asked, where do fitness functions come from, that's like asking the old meaning of life question, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: It's the why. Why? Why? And one of the big underlying why is, okay, you can start with evolution on earth,

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: but without living, without life and death, without the line between the living and the dead, you don't have evolution.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So what if underneath it, there's no such thing as the living and the dead?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: There's no... Like this concept of an organism, period. There's a living organism that's defined by a volume in space-time that somehow interacts,

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: that over time maintains its integrity somehow, it has some kind of history, it has a wall of some kind.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: The outside world, the environment, and then inside there's an organism. So you're defining an organism,

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: and also you define that organism by the fact that it can move and it can come alive, which you kind of think of as moving,

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: combined with the fact that it's keeping itself separate from the environment, so you can point out that thing is living, and then it can also die.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: That seems to be of all very powerful components of space-time that enable you to have something like natural selection and evolution.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Well, and there's a lot of interesting work, some of it by collaborators of Carl Friston and others,

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: where they have Bayes net kind of stuff that they build on the notion of a Markov blanket.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So you have some states within this network that are inside the blanket, then you have the blanket, and then the states outside the blanket.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: The states inside this Markov blanket are conditionally independent of the states outside the blanket conditioned on the blanket.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: What they're looking at is that the dynamics inside of the states inside the Markov blanket seem to be trying to estimate properties of the outside and react to them in a way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So it seems like you're doing probabilistic inferences in ways that might be able to keep you alive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So there's interesting work going on in that direction, but what I'm saying is something slightly different, and that is when I look at you, all I see is skin, hair, and eyes, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: That's all I see. But I know that there's a deeper reality. I believe that there's a much deeper reality.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: There's the whole world of your experiences, your thoughts, your hopes, your dreams.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: In some sense, the face that I see is just a symbol that I create, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And as soon as I look away, I delete that symbol. But I don't delete you. I don't delete the conscious experience, the whole world of your…

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So I'm only deleting an interface symbol, but that interface symbol is a portal, so to speak. Not a perfect portal, but a genuine portal into your beliefs, into your conscious experiences.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: That's why we can have a conversation. Your consciousness is genuinely affecting mine, and mine is genuinely affecting yours through these icons, which I create on the fly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: I create your face. When I look, I delete it. I don't create you, your consciousness. That's there all the time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So now when I look at a cat, I'm creating something that I still call living, and I still think is conscious.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: When I look at an ant, I create something that I still would call living, but maybe not conscious.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: When I look at something I call a virus, now I'm not even sure I would call it living.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And when I look at a proton, I would say I don't even think it's not alive at all.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: It could be that I'm nevertheless interacting with something that's just as conscious as you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: I'm not saying the proton is conscious. The face that I'm creating when I look at you, that face is not conscious.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293
