body.input: That face is a data structure in me. That face is an experience. It's not an experiencer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Similarly, a proton is something that I create when I look or do a collision in the Large Hadron Collider or something like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: But what is behind the entity in space-time? So I've got this space-time interface, and I've just got this entity that I call a proton.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: What is the reality behind it? Well, the physicists are finding these big, big structures, the amplitude hydron, the sociohedron.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: What's behind those? Could be consciousness, what I'm playing with.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: In which case, when I'm interacting with a proton, I could be interacting with consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Again, to be very, very clear, because it's easy to misunderstand, I'm not saying a proton is conscious.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Just like I'm not saying your face is conscious. Your face is a symbol I create and then delete as I look.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So your face is not conscious. But I know that that face in my interface, the Lex Friedman face that I create,

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: is an interface symbol that's a genuine portal into your consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: The portal is less clear for a cat, even less clear for an ant.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And by the time we get down to a proton, the portal is not clear at all.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: But that doesn't mean I'm not interacting with consciousness. It just means my interface gave up.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And there's some deeper reality that we have to go after.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So your question really forces out a big part of this whole approach that I'm talking about.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So this portal into consciousness, I wonder why you can't...

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Your portal is not as good to a cat, to a cat's consciousness, than it is to a human.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Does it have to do with the fact that you're human and just similar organisms,

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: organisms of similar complexity are able to create portals better to each other?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Or is it just as you get more and more complex, you get better and better portals?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Well, let me answer one aspect that I'm more confident about, then I'll speculate on that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Why is it that the portal is so bad with protons and elementary particles more generally?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So quarks, leptons, and gluons, and so forth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Well, the reason for that is because those are just symmetries of space-time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: More technically, they're irreducible representations of the Poincaré group of space-time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So they're just literally representations of the data structure of space-time that we're using.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So that's why they're not very much insightful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: They're just almost entirely tied to the data structure itself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: They're telling you only something about the data structure, not behind the data structure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: It's only when we get to higher levels that we're starting to, in some sense,

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: build portals to what's behind space-time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Sure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Yeah, so there's more and more complexity built on top of the interface of space-time with the cat.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So you can actually build a portal, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Yeah, right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Yeah, this interface of face and hair and so on, skin.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: There's some syncing going on between humans though, where we sync.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: You're getting a pretty good representation of the ideas in my head

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: and starting to get a foggy view of my memories in my head.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Even though this is the first time we're talking, you start to project your own memories.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: You start to solve a giant hierarchy of puzzles about a human.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Because there's a lot of similarities, a lot of it rhymes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So you start to make a lot of inferences and you build up this model of a person.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: You have a pretty sophisticated model what's going on underneath.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Again, I wonder if it's possible to construct these models about each other

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: and nevertheless be very distant from an underlying reality.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: There's a lot of work on this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So there's some interesting work called Signaling Games where they look at how people can coordinate

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: and come to communicate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: There's some interesting work that was done by some colleagues and friends of mine,

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Louis Nerens, Natalia Komarova, and Kimberly Jamieson,

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: where they were looking at evolving color words.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So you have a circle of colors, the color circle.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: They wanted to see if they could get people to cooperate

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: and how they carved the color circle up into two units of words.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So they had a game theoretic kind of thing that they had people do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: What they found was that when they included, so most people are trichromats,

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: you have three kinds of cone photoreceptors, but there are some, a lot of men,

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: 7% of men are dichromats, they might be missing the red cone photoreceptor.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: They found that the dichromats had an outsized influence on the final ways

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: that the whole space of colors was carved up and labels attached.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: You needed to be able to include the dichromats in the conversation,

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: so they had a bigger influence on how you made the boundaries of the language.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: I thought that was a really interesting kind of insight, that there's going to be, again,

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: a game, perhaps a game or evolutionary or genetic algorithm kind of thing that goes on

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: in terms of learning to communicate in ways that are useful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And so, yeah, you can use game theory to actually explore that or signaling games.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: There's a lot of brilliant work on that. I'm not doing it, but there's work out there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So if it's okay, let us tackle once more and perhaps several more times

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: after the big topic of consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Okay.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: This very beautiful, powerful things that perhaps is the thing that makes us human.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: What is it? What's the role of consciousness in, let's say,

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: even just the thing we've been talking about, which is the formation of this interface?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Any kind of ways you want to kind of start talking about it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Well, let me say first what most of my colleagues say.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Ninety-nine percent are, again, assuming that space-time is fundamental,

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: particles in space-time, matter is fundamental, and most are reductionist.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And so the standard approach to consciousness is to figure out what complicated systems of matter

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: with the right functional properties could possibly lead to the emergence of consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: That's the general idea, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So maybe you have to have neurons. Maybe only if you have neurons, but that might not be enough.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: They have to have certain kinds of complexity in their organization and their dynamics,

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: certain kind of network abilities, for example.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So there are those who say, for example, that consciousness arises from orchestrated collapse

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: of quantum states of microtubules and neurons.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So this is Hamra from Kenrose.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So you start with something physical, a property of quantum states of microtubules and neurons.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And you say that somehow an orchestrated collapse of those is consciousness or conscious experiences.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Or integrated information theory. Again, you start with something physical.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And if it has the right kind of functional properties,

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: it's something they call phi with the right kind of integrated information, then you have consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Or you can be a panpsychist, Philip Goff, for example, where you might say,

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: well, in addition to the particles in space and time, those particles are not just matter.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: They also could have a unit of consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: But once again, you're taking space and time and particles as fundamental.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And you're adding a new property to them, say, consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And then you have to talk about how when a proton and electron get together to form hydrogen,

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: then how those consciousnesses merge or interact to create the consciousness of hydrogen and so forth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: There's attention schema theory, which again, this is how neural network processes representing to the network itself,

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: its attentional processes, that could be consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: There's global workspace theory and neuronal global workspace theory.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So there's many, many theories of this type.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: What's common to all of them is they assume that space-time is fundamental.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: They assume that physical processes in space-time is fundamental.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Panpsychism adds consciousness as an additional thing, it's almost dualist in that regard.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And my attitude is our best science is telling us that space-time is not fundamental.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So why is that important here?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Well, for centuries, deep thinkers thought of Earth, air, fire, and water as the fundamental elements.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: It was a reductionist kind of idea.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Nothing was more elemental than those and you could sort of build everything up from those.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: When we got the periodic table of elements, we realized that of course we want to study Earth, air, fire, and water.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: There's combustion science for fire.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: There's sciences for all these other things, water and so forth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So we're going to do science with these things, but fundamental? No.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: If you're looking for something fundamental, those are the wrong building blocks.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Earth has many, many different kinds of elements that project into the one thing that we call Earth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: If you don't understand that there's silicon, that there's iron, that there's all these different kinds of things that project into what we call Earth,

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: you're hopelessly lost. You're not fundamental. You're not going to get there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Then after the periodic table, then we came up with quarks, leptons, and gluons, the particles of the standard model of physics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So we actually now know that if you really want to get fundamental, the periodic table isn't it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: It's good for chemistry. It's just wonderful for chemistry.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: But if you're trying to go deep, fundamental, what is the fundamental science? That's not it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: You're going to have to go to quarks, leptons, and gluons, and so forth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Well, now we've discovered space-time itself is doomed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Quarks, leptons, and gluons are just irreducible representations of the symmetries of space-time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So the whole framework on which consciousness research is being based right now is doomed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And for me, these are my friends and colleagues that are doing this. They're brilliant.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: They're brilliant. My feeling is I'm so sad that they're stuck with this old framework

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: because if they weren't stuck like with Earth, air, fire, and water, you could actually make progress.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So it doesn't matter how smart you are. If you start with Earth, air, fire, and water, you're not going to get anywhere, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Actually, just because the word doomed is so interesting. Let me give you some options.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Multiple choice quiz. Is space-time, we could say, is reality the way we perceive it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Doomed, wrong, or fake?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Because doomed just means it could still be right and we're now ready to go deeper.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: It would be that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So it's not wrong. It's not a complete deviation from a journey toward the truth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Right. It's like Earth, air, fire, and water is not wrong. There is Earth, air, fire, and water.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: That's a useful framework, but it's not fundamental.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Right. Well, there's also wrong, which is they used to believe, as I recently learned, that George Washington was the first president of the United States,

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: was bled to death for something that could have been easily treated because it was believed that you can get,

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: actually, I need to look into this further, but I guess you get toxins out or demons out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: I don't know what you're getting out with the bleeding of a person.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So that ended up being wrong, but widely believed as a medical tool.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So it's also possible that our assumption of space-time is not just doomed, but is wrong.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Well, if we believe that it's fundamental, that's wrong. But if we believe it's a useful tool, that's right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: But bleeding somebody to death was believed to be a useful tool.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And that was wrong.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: It wasn't just not fundamental. It was very... I'm sure there's cases in which bleeding somebody would work,

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: but it would be a very tiny, tiny, tiny percentage of cases. So it could be that it's wrong.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Like it's a side road that's ultimately leading to a dead end as opposed to a truck stop or something that you can get off of.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: My feeling is not the dead end kind of thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: I think that what the physicists are finding is that there are these structures beyond space-time, but they project back into space-time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And so space-time, when they say space-time is doomed, they're explicit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: They're saying it's doomed in the sense that we thought it was fundamental. It's not fundamental.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: It's a useful, absolutely useful and brilliant data structure, but there are deeper data structures like cosmological polytope.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And space-time is not fundamental.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: What is doomed in the sense that it's wrong is reductionism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Which is saying space-time is fundamental.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Right. Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: The idea that somehow being smaller in space and time or space-time is a fundamental nature of reality, that's just wrong.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: It turned out to be a useful heuristic for thermodynamics and so forth and several other places.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Reductionism has been very useful, but that's in some sense an artifact of how we use our interface.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Yes. You're saying size doesn't matter. Okay. This is very important for me to write down. Ultimately.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Ultimately. Right. It's useful for theories like thermodynamics and also for understanding brain networks in terms of individual neurons and neurons in terms of chemical systems inside cells.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: That's all very, very useful. But the idea that we're getting to the more fundamental nature of reality, no.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: When you get all the way down in that direction, you get down to the quarks and gluons.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: What you realize is what you've gotten down to is not fundamental reality, just the irreducible representations of a data structure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: That's all you've gotten down to. So you're always stuck inside the data structure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So you seem to be getting closer and closer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: I went from neural networks to neurons, neurons to chemistry, chemistry to particles, particles to quarks and gluons.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: I'm getting closer and closer to the real. No, I'm getting closer and closer to the actual structure of the data structure of space and time, the irreducible representations.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: That's what you're getting closer to, not to a deeper understanding of what's beyond space time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: We'll also refer, we'll return again to this question of dynamics because you keep saying that space time is doomed, but mostly focusing on the space part of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: It's very interesting to see why time gets the bad cred too, because how do you have dynamics with our time is the thing I'd love to talk to you a little bit about.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: But let us return your brilliant whirlwind overview of the different theories of consciousness that are out there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: What is consciousness if outside of space time?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: If we think that we want to have a model of consciousness, we as scientists then have to say, what do we want to write down?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: What kind of mathematical model are we going to write down?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: If you think about it, there's lots of things that you might want to write down about consciousness. It's a really complicated subject.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Most of my colleagues are saying, let's start with matter or neurons and see what properties of matter could create consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: But I'm saying that that whole thing is out. Space time is doomed. That whole thing is out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: We need to look at consciousness qua consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: In other words, not as something that arises in space and time, but perhaps as something that creates space and time as a data structure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So what do we want? And here again, there's no hard and fast rule, but what you as a scientist have to do is to pick what you think are the minimal assumptions that are going to allow you to boot up a comprehensive theory.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: That is the trick. So what do I want? So what I chose to do was to have three things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: I said that there are conscious experiences, feeling of headache, the smell of garlic, experiencing the color red.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Those are conscious. So that's the primitive of the theory. And the reason I want few primitives, why?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Because those are the miracles of the theory, right? The primitives, the assumptions of the theory are the things you're not going to explain. Those are the things you assume.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And those experiences you particularly mean there is a subjectiveness to them. That's the thing when people refer to the hard problem of consciousness is it feels like something to look at the color red.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Exactly right. It feels like something to have a headache or to feel upset to your stomach. It feels like something.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And so I'm going to grant that in this theory there are experiences and they're fundamental in some sense. So conscious experience.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So they're not derived from physics. They're not functional properties of particles. They are sui generis. They exist. Just like we assume space time exists.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: I'm now saying space time is just a data structure. It doesn't exist independent of conscious experiences.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Sorry to interrupt once again, but should we be focusing in your thinking on humans alone?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Or is there something about in relation to other kinds of organisms that have a sufficiently high level of complexity?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Or even or is there some kind of generalization of the panpsychus idea that all consciousness permeates all matter?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Outside of the usual definition of what matter is inside space time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So it's beyond human consciousness. Human consciousness from my point of view would be one of a countless variety of consciousnesses.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And even within human consciousness, there's a there's countless variety of consciousness within us. Right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: I mean, you have your left and right hemisphere.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And apparently if you split the corpus callosum, the personality of the left hemisphere and the religious beliefs of the left hemisphere can be very different from the right hemisphere.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And their conscious experiences can be disjoint. One could have one conscious experience. They can play 20 questions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: The left hemisphere can have an idea in its mind and the right hemisphere has to guess and it might not get it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So even within you, there is more than just one consciousness. It's lots of consciousnesses.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So the general theory of consciousness that I'm after is not just human consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: It's going to be just consciousness. And I presume human consciousness is a tiny drop in the bucket of the infinite variety of consciousnesses.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: The black cat.

body.input: Intuitively. That's just a shout out. Sorry to distract. So that's the first assumption.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So I call this a conscious agent. This technical thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Now, Anika Harris and I have talked about this and she rightly cautions me that people will think that I'm bringing in a notion of a self or agency and so forth when I say conscious agent.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So I just want to say that I use the term conscious agent merely as a technical term.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: There is no notion of self in my fundamental definition of a conscious agent.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: There are only experiences and probabilistic relationships of how they trigger other experiences.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So the agent is the generator of the conscious experience?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: The agent is a mathematical structure that includes a probability measure, a probability space of possible conscious experiences and a Markovian kernel which describes how if this agent has certain conscious experiences, how that will affect the experiences of other conscious agents, including itself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: But you don't think of that as a self?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: No, there is no notion of a self here. There's no notion of really of an agent.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: But is there a locality? Is there an organism?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: There's no space.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So these are conscious units, conscious entities.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: But they're distinct in some way because they have to interact.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Well, so here's the interesting thing. When we write down the mathematics, when you have two of these conscious agents interacting, the pair satisfy a definition of a conscious agent.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So they are a single conscious agent. So there is one conscious agent.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: But it has a nice analytic decomposition into as many conscious agents as you wish.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So that's a nice interface.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: It's a very useful scientific interface.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: It's a scale-free or if you like a fractal-like approach to it in which we can use the same unit of analysis at all scales in studying consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: But if I want to talk about so there's no notion of learning, memory, problem solving, intelligence, self, agency.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So none of that is fundamental.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So and the reason I did that was because I want to assume as little as possible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Everything I assume is a miracle in the theory. It's not something you explain. It's something you assume.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So I have to build networks of conscious agents.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: If I want to have a notion of a self, I have to build a self.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: I have to build learning, memory, problem solving, intelligence and planning, all these different things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: I have to build networks of conscious agents to do that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: It's a trivial theorem that networks of conscious agents are computationally universal. That's trivial.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So anything that we can do with neural networks or automata, you can do with networks of conscious agents. That's trivial.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: But you can also do more. The events in the probability space need not be computable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So the Markovian dynamics is not restricted to computable functions because the very events themselves need not be computable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So this can capture any computable theory.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Anything we can do with neural networks, we can do with conscious agent networks.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: But it leaves open the door for the possibility of non-computable interactions between conscious agents.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So we have to, if we want a theory of memory, we have to build it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And there's lots of different ways you could build. We've actually got a paper. Chris Fields took the lead on this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: We have a paper called Conscious Agent Networks where Chris takes the lead and shows how to use these networks of conscious agents to build memory and to build primitive kinds of learning.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: But can you provide some intuition of what conscious networks, networks of conscious agents, helps you?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Well, first of all, what that looks like. And I don't just mean mathematically. Of course, maybe that might help build up intuition.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: But how that helps us potentially solve the hard problem of consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Or is that baked in, that that exists?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Can you solve the hard problem of consciousness? Why it tastes delicious when you eat a delicious ice cream with networks of conscious agents? Or is that taken as an assumption?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So the standard way the hard problem is thought of is we're assuming space and time and particles or neurons, for example.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: These are just physical things that have no consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And we have to explain how the conscious experience of the taste of chocolate could emerge from those.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So that's the typical hard problem of consciousness is that problem. Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: How do you boot up the taste of chocolate, the experience of the taste of chocolate from neurons, say, or the right kind of artificial intelligence circuitry?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: How do you boot that up? That's typically what the hard problem of consciousness means to researchers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Notice that I'm changing the problem. I'm not trying to boot up conscious experiences from the dynamics of neurons or silicon or something like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: I'm saying that that's the wrong problem. My hard problem would go in the other direction.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: If I start with conscious experiences, how do I build up space and time? How do I build up what I call the physical world?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: How do I build up what we call brains? Because I'm saying consciousness is not something that brains do. Brains are something that consciousness makes up.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: It's among the experience. It's an ephemeral experience in consciousness. I look inside. So to be very, very clear, right now I have no neurons.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: If you looked, you would see neurons. That's a data structure that you would create on the fly. And it's a very useful one.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: As soon as you look away, you garbage collect that data structure. Just like that NecroCube that I was talking about on the piece of paper.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: When you look, you see a 3D cube. You create it on the fly. As soon as you look away, that's gone.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: When you say you, you mean a human being scientist.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Right now, that's right. More generally, it'll be conscious agents because as you pointed out, am I asking for a theory of consciousness only about humans?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: No, it's consciousness, which human consciousness is just a tiny sliver.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: But you are saying that there is a useful data structure. How many other data structures are there? That's why I said you human.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: If there's another Earth, if there's another alien civilization and doing these kinds of investigations, would they come up with similar data structures?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Probably not.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: What is the space of data structures, I guess is what I'm asking.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: My guess is that if consciousness is fundamental, consciousness is all there is, then the only thing that mathematical structure can be about is possibilities of consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: That suggests to me that there could be an infinite variety of consciousnesses and a vanishingly small fraction of them use space-time data structures, the kinds of structures that we use.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: There's an infinite variety of data structures.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Now, this is very similar to something that Max Tegmark has said, but I want to distinguish it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: He has this level four multiverse idea. He thinks that mathematics is fundamental.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: That's the fundamental reality. Since there's an infinite variety of mathematical structures, there's an infinite variety of multiverses, in his view.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: I'm saying something similar in spirit, but importantly different. There's an infinite variety of mathematical structures, absolutely.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: But mathematics isn't the fundamental reality in this framework. Consciousness is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Mathematics is to consciousness like bones are to an organism. You need the bones.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Mathematics is not divorced from consciousness, but it's not the entirety of consciousness by any means.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: There's an infinite variety of consciousnesses and signaling games that consciousnesses could interact via.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Therefore, common worlds, data structures that they can use to communicate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Space and time is just one of an infinite variety.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: I think that what we'll find is that as we go outside of our little space-time bubble, we will encounter utterly alien forms of conscious experience

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: that we may not be able to really comprehend in the following sense.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: If I ask you to imagine a color that you've never seen before, does anything happen?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Nothing happens. That's just one color. I'm asking for just a color.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: We actually know, by the way, that apparently there are women called tetrafams who have four color receptors, not just three.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Kimberly Jamieson and others who've studied these women have good evidence that they apparently have a new dimension of color experience that the rest of us don't have.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: These women are apparently living in a world of color that you and I can't even concretely imagine. No man can imagine them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Yet, they're real color experiences. In that sense, I'm saying, now take that little baby step, oh, there are women who have color experiences that I could never have.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Well, that's shocking. Now take that infinite.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: There are consciousnesses where every aspect of their experiences is like that new color. It's something utterly alien to you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: You have nothing like that. Yet, these are all possible varieties of conscious experience.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: When you say there's a lot of consciousnesses, it's a singular consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Basically, the set of possible experiences you can have in that subjective way as opposed to the underlying mechanism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: You say that having an extra color receptor, ability to have new experiences, that somehow a different consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Is there a way to see that as all the same consciousness, the subjectivity itself?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Right. When we have two of these conscious agents interacting in mathematics, they actually satisfy the definition of a conscious agent.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: In fact, they are a single conscious agent.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: In fact, one way to think about what I'm saying, I'm postulating with my colleagues, Chetan and Chris and others, Robert Prentner and so forth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: There is one big conscious agent, infinitely complicated.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Fortunately, we can, for analytic purposes, break it down all the way to, in some sense, the simplest conscious agent, which has one conscious experience.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: This one agent can experience red 35. That's it. That's what it experiences. You can get all the way down to that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So you think it's possible that consciousness, whatever that is, is fundamental, or at least much more in the direction of the fundamental than is space-time as we perceive it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: That's the proposal. Therefore, what I have to do in terms of the heart problem of consciousness is to show how dynamical systems of conscious agents could lead to what we call space and time and neurons and brain activity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: In other words, we have to show how you get space-time and physical objects entirely from a theory of conscious agents outside of space-time with the dynamics outside of space-time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: I can tell you how we plan to do that, but that's the idea.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Okay. The magic of it, that chocolate is delicious. So there's a mathematical kind of thing that we could say here, how it can emerge within the system of networks of conscious agents.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: But is there going to be at the end of the proof why chocolate is so delicious? Or no? I guess I'm going to ask different kinds of dumb questions to try to sneak up.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Oh, well, that's the right question. And when I say that I took conscious experiences as fundamental, what that means is in the current version of my theory, I'm not explaining conscious experiences where they came from.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: That's the miracle. That's one of the miracles. So I have two miracles in my theory. There are conscious experiences like the taste of chocolate and that there's a probabilistic relationship.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: When certain conscious experiences occur, others are more likely to occur. Those are the two miracles that are possible to get beyond that and somehow start to chip away at the miracleness of that miracle.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: That chocolate is delicious.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: I hope so. I've got my hands full with what I'm doing right now, but I can just say at top level how I would think about that. That would get at this consciousness without form.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: This is going to be really tough because it's consciousness without form versus the various forms that consciousness takes for the experiences that it has.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Right. So when I write down a probability space for these conscious experiences, I say here's a probability space for the possible conscious experiences.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: It's just like when I write down a probability space for an experiment. I'm going to flip a coin twice. I want to look at the probabilities of various outcomes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So I have to write down a probability space. There could be heads, heads, heads, tails, tails, heads, tails, tails. So any class in probability you're told write down your probability space.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: If you don't write down your probability space, you can't get started. So here's my probability space for consciousness. How do I want to interpret that structure?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: The structure is just sitting there. There's going to be a dynamics that happens on it. Experiences appear and then disappear just like heads appears and disappears.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So one way to think about that fundamental probability space is that corresponds to consciousness without any content.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: The infinite consciousness that transcends any particular content.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: What do you think of that as a mechanism as a thing like the rules that govern the dynamics of the thing outside of space time? Isn't that if you think consciousness fundamental, isn't it essentially getting like it is solving the hard problem,

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: which is like from where does this thing pop up,

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: which is the mechanism of the thing popping up, whatever the consciousness is, the different kinds of was so on that mechanism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And also the question I want to ask is how how tricky do you think it is to solve that problem?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: You solved a lot of difficult problems throughout the history of humanity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: There's probably more problems to solve left than we've solved by like an infinity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: But along that long journey of intelligent species, how when will we solve this consciousness one is one way to measure the difficulty of the problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So I'll give two answers. There's one problem I think we can solve.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: But we haven't solved yet. And that is the reverse of what my colleagues call the hard problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: The problem of how do you start with conscious experiences in the way that I've just described them and the dynamics and build up space and time and brains.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: That I think is a tough technical problem, but some principle solvable. So I think we can solve that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So we would solve the hard problem not by showing our brains create consciousness, but how networks of conscious agents create what we call the symbols that we call brains.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So that I think. But that does that allow you to say that's interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: That's an interesting idea. Consciousness creates the brain, not the brain creates consciousness. But does that allow you to build the thing?
