body.input: You as a human being, as a mortal human being, how has these theories been to you personally? Are there good days and bad days when you wake up and look in the mirror and the fact that you can't see anything behind you?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: The fact that it's rendered. Like, is there interesting quirks? You know, Nietzsche with his, if you gaze long into the abyss, the abyss gazes into you. How has these theories, these ideas changed you as a person?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: It's been very, very difficult. This stuff is not just abstract theory building because it's about us. Sometimes I've realized that there's this big division in me. My mind is doing all the science and coming up with these conclusions and the rest of me is not integrating.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: I'm just like, I don't believe it. I just don't believe this. So as I start to take it seriously, I get scared myself. But then I read these spiritual traditions and realize they're saying very, very similar things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: It's like there's a lot of convergence. So for me, the first time I thought it might be possible that we're not seeing the truth was in 1986. It was from some mathematics we were doing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And when that hit me, it hit me like a ton of bricks. I had to sit down. It was scary. It was really a shock to the system. And then to realize that everything that has been important to me, like getting a house, getting a car, getting a reputation and so forth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Well, that car is just like the car I see in the virtual reality. It's there when you perceive it and it's not there. So the whole question of what am I doing and why, what's worthwhile doing in life?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Clearly, getting a big house and getting a big car. I mean, we all knew that we were going to die. So we tend not to know that. We tend to hide it, especially when we were young. Before age 30, we don't believe we're going to die.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: We factually maybe know that you kind of are supposed to. Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: But they'll figure something out and we'll be the generation that is the first one that doesn't have to die. That's the kind of thing. But when you really face the fact that you're going to die.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And then when I start to look at it from this point of view that, well, this thing was an interface to begin with. So what I'm really going to be doing, just taking off a headset.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So I've been playing in a virtual reality game all day and I got lost in the game when I was fighting over a Porsche.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And I shot some guys up and I punctured their tires and I got the Porsche. Now I take the headset off. And what was that for? Nothing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: It was just, it was a data structure and the data structure is gone. So all of the wars, the fighting and the reputations and all this stuff, you know, it's just a headset.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So now, and so my theory says that intellectually, my mind, my emotions, rebel all over the place. This is like, you know, and so I have to meditate. I meditate a lot.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: What percent of the day would you say you spend as a physicalist, sort of living life, pretending your car matters, your reputation matter? Like, like how much was that Tom Waits song?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: I like my town with a little drop of poison. How much poison do you allow yourself to have?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: I think my default mode is physicalist. I think that that's just the default. I, when I'm not being conscious, consciously attentive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Intellectually consciously attentive. Because if you're just, you're still, if you're tasting coffee and not thinking or drinking or just taking in the sunset, you're not being intellectual, but you're still experiencing it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So it's when you turn on the, like the introspective machine, that's when you can start. And turn off the thinker. When I actually just start looking without thinking.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So that's, that's when I feel like I, all of a sudden I'm starting to see through.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Sort of like, okay, part of, part of the addiction to the interface is all the stories I'm telling about it. It's really important for me to get that, really important to do that. So I'm telling all these stories and so I'm all wrapped up.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Almost all of the mind stuff that's going on in my head is about attachment to the interface.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And so what I found is that the, essentially the only way to really detach from the interface is to literally let go of thoughts altogether.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And then all of a sudden, even my identity, my whole history, my name, my education, all this stuff is almost irrelevant because it's just now here is the present moment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And this is, this is the reality right now. And all of that other stuff is an interface story. But this conscious experience right now, this is the only, this is the only reality as far as I can tell.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: The rest of it's a story. And, but that is again, not my default. That is, I have to make a really conscious choice to say, okay, I know intellectually this is all an interface.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: I'm going to take the headset off and so forth and then immediately sink back into the game and just be out there playing the game and get lost. And so I'm always lost in the game unless I literally consciously choose to stop thinking.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Isn't it terrifying to acknowledge that, to look beyond the game? Isn't it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: It scares the hell out of me. It really is scary because I'm so attached. I'm attached to this body. I'm attached to the interface.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Are you ever worried about breaking your brain a bit? Meaning like, it's a, I mean, some of these ideas, when you think about reality, even with like Einstein, just realizing you said interface, just realizing that light, you know, that there's a speed of light and you can't go fast in the speed of light.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And like what kind of things, black holes and can do with light. Even that can mess with your head. Yes. But that's still space time. That's a big mess, but it's still just space time. It's still a property of our interface. That's right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: But it's still like even, even Einstein realized that this particular thing, some of the stories you tell ourselves is constructing interfaces that are oversimplifying the way things work. Because it's nice. The stories are nice. Stories are nice. I mean, just like video games. They're nice.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Right. But Einstein was a realist, right? He was a famous realist in the sense that he was very explicit on 1935 paper with Podolsky and Rosen, the EPR paper, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: They said, if without in any way disturbing a system, I can predict with probability one, the outcome of a measurement, then there exists in reality that element, right? That value. And we now know from quantum theory that that's false.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: That Einstein's idea of local realism is strictly speaking false. And so we can predict, we can set up in quantum theory, you can set up and there's a paper by Chris Fuchs, quantum Bayesianism, where he scouts this out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: It was done by the people, but he gives a good presentation of this, where they have a sequence of something like nine different quantum measurements that you can make.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And you can predict with probability one what a particular outcome will be, but you can actually prove that it's impossible that the value existed before you made the measurement.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So you know with probability one what you're going to get, but you also know with certainty that that value was not there until you made the measurement.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So we know from quantum theory that the act of observation is an act of fact creation. And that is built into what I'm saying with this theory of consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: If consciousness is fundamental, space time itself is an act of fact creation. It's an interface that we create, consciousness creates, plus all the objects in it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So local realism is not true. Quantum theory is established, also non-contextual realism is not true. And that fits in perfectly with this idea that consciousness is fundamental.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: These things are, these exist as data structures when we create them. As Chris Fuchs says, the act of observation is an act of fact creation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: But I must say on a personal level, I'm having to spend, I spend a couple hours a day just sitting in meditation on this and facing the rebellion in me that goes to the core, it feels like it goes to the core of my being, rebellion against these ideas.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So here it's very, very interesting for me to look at this because, so here I'm a scientist and I'm a person. The science is really clear.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Local realism is false, non-contextual realism is false, space time is doomed. It's very, very clear. It couldn't be clearer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And my emotions rebel left and right when I sit there and say, okay, I am not something in space and time. Something inside of me says, you're crazy. Of course you are.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And I'm completely attached to it. I'm completely attached to all this stuff. I'm attached to my body. I'm attached to the headset. I'm attached to my car, attached to people. I'm attached to all of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And yet I know as an absolute fact, I'm going to walk away from all of it. I'm going to die.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: In fact, I almost died last year. COVID almost killed me. I sent a goodbye text to my wife. So I thought I was done.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: You really did.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: I sent her a goodbye. I was in the emergency room and it had attacked my heart and it had been at 190 beats per minute for 36 hours. I couldn't last much longer. I knew they couldn't stop it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: That was it. So I texted her goodbye from the emergency room.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: I love you goodbye kind of thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Yeah, right. Yeah. That was it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Were you afraid?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Yeah, it scares the hell out of you, right? But you're just feeling so bad anyway. You're scared, but you're just feeling so bad that in some sense you just want it to stop anyway.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So I've been there and faced it just a year ago.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: How did that change you, by the way? Having this intellectual reality that's so challenging that you meditate on. It's just an interface.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And one of the hardest things to come to terms with is that that means that it's going to end.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: How did that change you having come so close to the reality of it? It's not just an intellectual reality. It's a reality of death.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: I've meditated for 20 years now. I would say averaging three or four hours a day.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: But it's put a new urgency. Urgency is not the right word because it's riveted my attention. I'll put it that way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: It's really riveted my attention and I've really paid. I spent a lot more time looking at what spiritual traditions say.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: I don't, by the way, again, not taking it with a, you know, take it all with a grain of salt.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: But on the other hand, I think it's stupid for me to ignore it. So I try to listen to the best ideas and to sort out nonsense from.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And it's just, we all have to do it for ourselves, right? It's not easy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So what makes sense, and I have the advantage of some science so I can look at what science says and try to compare with spiritual tradition.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: I try to sort it out for myself. But then I also look and realize that there's another aspect to me, which is this whole emotional aspect.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: I seem to be wired up. As evolutionary psychology says, I'm wired up, right? All these defensive mechanisms.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: I'm inclined to lie if I need to. I'm inclined to be angry, to protect myself, to have an in-group and an out-group, to try to make my reputation as big as possible, to try to demean the out-group.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: There's all these things that evolutionary psychology is spot on. It's really brilliant about the human condition.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And yet I think evolution, as I said, evolutionary theory is a projection of a deeper theory where there may be no competition.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So I'm in this very interesting position where I feel like, okay, according to my own theory, I'm consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And maybe this is what it means for consciousness to wake up. It's not easy. It's almost like I feel like I have real skin in the game.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: It really is scary. I really was scared when I was about to die. It really was hard to say goodbye to my wife. It really pained.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And to then look at that and then look at the fact that I'm going to walk away from this anyway and it's just an interface.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So it's trying to put all this stuff together and really grok it, so to speak, not just intellectually, but grok it at an emotional level.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Yeah. What are you afraid of, you silly evolved organism that's gotten way too attached to the interface?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: What are you really afraid of?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: That's right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Is there a...

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Very personal. You know, it's very, very personal.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: I mean, speaking of the text, what do you think is this whole love thing? What's the role of love in our human condition?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: This interface thing we have, is it somehow interweaved, interconnected with consciousness?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: This attachment we have to other humans and this deep...

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Like there's some quality to it that seems very interesting, peculiar.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Well, there are two levels I would think about that. There's love in the sexual sense and then there's love in a deeper sense.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And in the sexual sense, we can give an evolutionary account of that and so forth. I think that's pretty clear to people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: In this deeper sense...

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Right. So of course, I married...I love my wife in a sexual sense, but there was a deeper sense as well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: When I was saying goodbye to her, there was a much deeper love that was really at play there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: That's one place where I think that the mixed bag from spiritual traditions has something right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: When they say, you know, love your neighbor as yourself, that in some sense love is fundamental, I think that they're on to something, something very, very deep and profound.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And every once in a while I can get a personal glimpse of that, especially when I'm in the space with no thought.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: When I can really let go of thoughts, I get little glimpses of a love in the sense that I'm not separate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: It's a love in the sense that I'm not different from that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: If you and I are separate, then I can fight you. But if you and I are the same, if there's a union there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: The togetherness of it. Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: What...who's God? All those gods, the stories that have been told throughout history, you said, through the spiritual traditions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: What do you think that is? Is that us trying to find that common thing at the core?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Well, in many traditions, not all.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: The one I was raised in, so my dad was a Protestant minister.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: We tend to think of God as a being.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: But I think that that's not right. I think the closest way to think about God is being, period.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Not a being, but being. The very ground of being itself is God.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: I think that's the deep...and from my point of view, that's the ground of consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So the ground of conscious being is what we might call God.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: But the word God has always been, you know, for example, you don't believe the same God as my God, so I'm going to fight you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: We'll have wars over because the being, the specific being that you call God is different from the being that I call God, and so we fight.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Whereas if it's not a being, but just being, and you and I share a being, then you and I are not separate and there's no reason to fight.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: We're both part of that one being, and loving you is loving myself because we're all part of that one being.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: The spiritual traditions that point to that, I think, are pointing in a very interesting direction.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And that does seem to match with the mathematics of the conscious agent stuff that I've been working on as well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: It really fits with that, although that wasn't my goal.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: You mentioned that the young physicists that you talk to or whose work you follow have quite a lot of fun breaking with the traditions of the past, the assumptions of the past.

body.input: I would say the universe is a lot more interesting than you might expect, and you are a lot more special and interesting than you might expect.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: You might think that you're just a little tiny, irrelevant, 100-pound, 200-pound person in a vast billions of light years across space.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And that's not the case.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: You are in some sense the being that's creating that space all the time every time you look.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So waking up to who you really are outside of space and time as the author of space and time is the author of everything that you see.

body.input: The author of space and time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And space and time is just one little data structure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: They're authors of various other things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: So realizing, and then realizing that I had this feeling growing up, going to college, reading all these texts, but oh man, it's all been done.

body.input: Well, believe me, the textbooks are going to look silly in 50 years, and it's your chance to write the new textbook.

body.input: So of course, study the current textbooks.

body.input: You have to understand them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: But then the only limit is your imagination, frankly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: That's the only limit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: The greatest books, the greatest textbooks ever written on Earth are yet to be written.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: Exactly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: What do you think is the meaning of this whole thing?

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: What's the meaning of life from your limited interface?

body.input: Why?

body.input: Yeah, that's the closest I've come.

body.input: That's a good first sentence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: and there's infinite variety of structures for consciousness to some sense explore,

metadata.title: Podcast: Donald Hoffman: Reality is an Illusion - How Evolution Hid the Truth | Lex Fridman Podcast #293

body.input: And the question that you asked, what is it all about, somehow it's related to that.
